rows.Subject: 0632 | Mr. Pei Sung Hsu | FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
12/31 23:00頃、ニューイヤーイベントの音楽に対して苦言の電話受け。
ゲストより、音楽がうるさい、これほど長いイベントを行うとは聞いておらず、就寝できない、マネージャーに伝え、何とか対応するようにと苦言あり。

速やかに折り返しのご連絡を行い、ご迷惑をおかけしたことへの謝罪とスリーピングルーム提供の提案を行うが、「部屋からの移動はしたくない」とのことで提案を拒否された。また、この件について絶対にクレームを出すと仰った。再度謝罪のうえ、翌日改めてお話をさせていただきたい旨をお伝え、終話。本日、アブデルさんがゲストにコンタクトする予定です。12/31 岩田

On December 31 around 23:00,  we received a call from a guest expressing concerns regarding the music at the New Year’s event.
The guest stated that the music was too loud,  that they had not been informed the event would last this long,  and that they were unable to sleep. They requested that the manager be informed and that some action be taken.
I promptly returned the call,  apologized for the inconvenience,  and offered a sleeping room. However,  the guest declined the offer,  stating that they did not want to move from their room. They also indicated that they would definitely file a formal complaint regarding this matter.
I apologized again and informed the guest that we would like to speak with them again the following day. The conversation ended at that point.
Abdel-san is scheduled to contact the guest today. 12/31 Iwata

1/1 23:20pm 
ISC宛に今日はイベントが無いのにロビーのBGMはいつまでうるさいんだ、と苦言。 
1980に早めにボリュームを下げるよう要請してから部屋に架電。 
静かにはなったがどうなっているんだと苦言。通常は深夜0時半頃に音を下げているが、 本日は早めに音を下げたと伝えた。 
5つ星なのに安眠を約束できないのはあり得ない、と呆れられた。1/1 西郷

1/1 23:20pm
ISC received a complaint stating that although there was no event today,  the lobby background music was still too loud and asking how long it would continue.
After requesting the team at 1980 to lower the volume earlier than usual,  we called the guest’s room. 
While it did become quieter,  the guest continued to complain,  asking what was going on. 
We explained that the volume is normally lowered around 12:30 a.m.,  but that on this day it was reduced earlier than usual.
The guest expressed frustration,  stating that it was unacceptable for a five-star hotel to be unable to guarantee a good night’s sleep.  1/1 Saigo

rows.Subject: 0610 | Mr. Shangwen Huang | FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
到着前からメールでスイートが事前に確約できない点に対してクレームがあり、複数回のメールのやりとりの中でゲストの強い要望を受け、GRMが例外的にスイートへのアップグレードを確約していた。

1/2 17:25到着時、チェックインカウンターが混雑しており、待たせたことと手荷物を運んでくれなかったことに対してクレーム。お詫びとしてカクテルアワーのビジターチャージを無料とした。
その後防犯カメラの映像を確認したところ、17:20にフロント前に到着しており、実際の待ち時間は5分ほどと思われる。
荷物についてもベルマンが適切に対応していた。
また、カクテルアワーおよび朝食利用時のスタッフに対する態度も粗雑であったとゲストリレーションズから報告があった。

その後部屋から氷のリクエストがあり、ベルマンがエレベーターホールの製氷機を案内したことに対してクレーム。
対応した田中DMが部屋に届ける旨案内したが不要となった。

22:00にゲストリレーションズ宛てに苦情メールを送ってきており、内容は
・到着時のベルサービスがない ― 防犯カメラで荷物を預かっていることを確認済み
・チェックイン待ち時間1時間 ― CCTVで約5分待ちであったことを確認済み
・アイスバケツ未提供 ― 標準手順通り製氷機の利用を案内済み
クラブラウンジへの不満 — 積極的なサービス不足、エッグステーションでの待ち時間、飲食の品質への不満。ゲストはエッグステーションに自ら行きオムレツを注文したが、完成前に列を離れたため、シェフは待機中の他のゲストを優先して対応した。

その後23:00にDMに苦情を言いたいとのことで連絡があったが、DMが救急搬送の対応中ですぐには連絡できない旨を伝えると翌朝に連絡するとして終話。

1/3 9:30頃 朝食で利用していたRCLからDMコール
・朝食時オムレツを頼んで列から離れてしまったため、オムレツが用意されていなかったことにクレーム。
・昨晩の氷はワインクーラーが欲しかったのに自分でやれ、と言われたことが不満だったとのこと。
・RCLのカクテルアワーも料理の質・量ともに不満
・世界中のハイアットを使っているがここはアメリカ並みにレベルが低い。
との苦情があった。
「で、ホテルはこれに対してどうするのか？」と遠回しに補償を要求してきたため、WOHポイント5, 000ポイントの付与を提案したが納得せず、上司に確認するとして終話。
その後アブデル課長との協議の結果、ゲストによる複数の不正確な主張を理由にポイントは付与しないこととなった。

結論
複数のゲストクレームは、CCTV映像及びスタッフ報告書により矛盾が確認された。
サービスはホテル基準に沿って提供され、追加の善意の配慮も既に実施済みである。
事実根拠の欠如及びゲストの行動を理由に補償請求は却下された。

佐藤


Pre-Arrival
Prior to arrival,  the guest raised a complaint via email regarding the inability to guarantee a suite upgrade in advance.
Following multiple email exchanges and strong insistence from the guest,  an advance-confirmed suite upgrade was exceptionally approved and confirmed by the GRM.
Arrival – 1/2 at approximately 17:25
Upon arrival,  the guest complained about waiting in queue for check-in and alleged that bell team didn't assist with the luggage .
The guest requested compensation and strongly insisted on complimentary Club Lounge access for 3rd person a non-staying friend,  which was exceptionally granted by the Duty Manager due to the guest’s persistent request.
Fact Review (CCTV & Team Verification)
CCTV footage confirms the guest arrived at the front desk area at 17:20 and waited approximately 5 minutes,  as the front desk agent was assisting another guest.
Bell service was provided appropriately,  and luggage handling was in line with hotel standards.
Guest Relations later reported rude behavior toward staff during Club Lounge cocktail hour and breakfast the following morning.
Same Day – Afternoon
The guest requested ice via in-room telephone and complained that the bellman directed them to the ice machine.
DM Tanaka informed the guest that ice would be delivered; however,  the guest later stated that it was no longer required.
Late Evening Complaint – 23:00
The guest contacted the Duty Manager to complain. DM explained that they were handling an emergency Ambulance and could not respond immediately.
The guest ended the call,  stating they would follow up the next morning.
Email Complaint Sent at 22:00 to Guest Relations
The guest reiterated the following claims:
No bell service upon arrival — CCTV confirmed assistance was provided.
Alleged one-hour wait for check-in — CCTV confirmed an approximate 5-minute wait.
No ice bucket provided — Guest was advised to use the ice machine,  which is standard practice.
Club Lounge dissatisfaction — Limited proactive service,  waiting times at the Egg station,  and dissatisfaction with food and beverage quality. The guest approached the egg station,  placed an omelet order,  but left the queue before completion the chef subsequently served other guests who were waiting.
Next Morning – 1/3
The guest met with the Duty Manager and requested compensation in the form of points.
After review with Abdel-san,  the request was declined due to multiple inaccurate statements made by the guest.
Conclusion
Multiple guest claims were reviewed and contradicted by CCTV evidence and staff reports.
Service was delivered in line with hotel standards,  with additional goodwill gestures already extended.
The request for compensation was declined due to lack of factual basis and guest conduct.
— Sato
rows.Feedback Remarks 1: OUT後1週間が経過したためCLOSEします　佐藤

rows.Subject: 1421 | Kadijah Means | HK Service Complaint 客室課サービス苦情　1/8OUT
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: HK Service Complaint 客室課サービス苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/3 15:00 フロントで以下のクレームを頂戴する
・朝8:30頃、着替え中に客室係が部屋に入ってきた。清掃は13時以降にしてほしい
・客室係に問い合わせて、折り返し電話するとのことだが1時間以上たっても連絡がない。
・コンシェルジュに問い合わせた際も折り返し電話するとのことで1時間以上たっても連絡がなかった。
ご不快な思いをさせたことをお詫びし、1/4-8の朝食を無料で提供することを伝えた。
あわせて今回はポイントを利用して宿泊しており、1泊分を返還してほしいとの要望もあったが断り済

事実関係を確認したところ、客室については10時頃メイクランプが点灯していたため、ノックのうえドアを少し開けて声掛けのみ行い、室内には入っていないとのことであった。また、11:17にISC経由で「12/30のステイメイクを13時に依頼していたにもかかわらず、8時にスタッフが訪室した」とのクレームがあり、詳細確認後に折り返す旨をお伝えしましたが、確認に時間を要してしまい、上記のフロントでのクレームにつながったものと思われる。
ロビーコンシェルジュについては1/1 15:15にFCSで外部レストランの営業時間と経路についての案内のオーダーが発行されており、16:41に完了となっていた。　佐藤


1/3 15:00 Received the following complaint at the front desk:
・Around 8:30 AM,  a housekeeping staff entered the room while the guest was changing clothes. The guest requested cleaning after 1:00 PM.
・The guest contacted housekeeping,  who said they would call back,  but no contact was made even after over an hour.
・When the guest contacted the concierge,  they were also told a call would be returned,  but no contact was made even after over an hour.
We apologized for the inconvenience and offered complimentary breakfasts from January 4th to 8th.
Additionally,  the guest requested a refund for one night since they used points for this stay,  but we declined.

Upon verifying the facts:
- Regarding the room,  the make-up light was on around 10:00 AM. The housekeeper knocked,  slightly opened the door,  and only called out; they did not enter the room. Additionally,  at 11:17 AM,  a complaint was received via ISC stating,  “Despite requesting the stay make-up service for December 30th at 1:00 PM,  a staff member visited the room at 8:00 AM.” We informed the guest we would call back after confirming the details,  but the verification process took longer than expected,  likely leading to the aforementioned complaint at the front desk.

rows.Incident Description:
コンシェルジュの応対は酷いとクレーム。1/3 西郷
Complaint Filed Over Appalling Concierge Service. 1/3 Saigo
rows.Subject: 1329 | Mrs. Wu Yan | FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/3 23:27pm
ISC経由でご主人からｺﾝｼｪﾙｼﾞｭに対し苦情。対面での会話を希望し快諾された。
苦情の内容は奥様がリムジンバスの予約するだけで45分もかかった、とのこと。
自分で予約を試みたが予約が出来ず、コンシェルジュが手伝うことになった。
最終的にはコンシェルジュ側で代理で予約することで可能になったが、
ならば最初からそうすれば良かったのに無駄に時間を費やされた、とのこと。
また隣にいた男性スタッフに対し「お前はインチャージなのか？」と尋ねると
「インチャージはフロントにいる男性だ」と言うだけだった。
苦情を述べている間かなりヒートアップし、日中関係は問題を抱えているが、
私にはそのことは関係無い。しかしながらこれは中国に対する人種差別ではないか？と疑いをかけられる。
ご主人に対して丁重にお詫びし、私たちスタッフは差別的な意図は全くない、
お客様に対し親切では無かったし、スタッフ間でも親切では無かった。
もちろん機転を利かせることも出来なかった、と説明。その点はご理解頂けた。
GMとの対話を求められたが、この件はフロント・コンシェルジュで対応すると伝えた。
明日朝9時にC/OUTするので改めてインチャージと話をすることで終話となった。 
担当スタッフに状況を確認すると、リムジンバスの予約の仕方を聞かれた時間を含めると40分弱。
当初はレギュレーション通りご自身で予約して頂くことをお願いしていた。
ただこの方のクレジットカードが中々認証されず、時間を要することになったとのこと。
そこへご主人が現れ「現金払いならどうなるのか？」と尋ねられ、
バスタ新宿まで行ってそこで支払うとレギュレーション通りの回答をしていた。
しかし最終的にはコンシェルジュが代行で予約を行ったことで、
バスタ新宿まで向かわせる案内が差別的と捉えられてしまった。 1/3 西郷

1/3 22:27pm
A complaint was received by the Concierge via ISC from the guest’s husband.
He requested a face-to-face discussion,  which was accepted.

The complaint concerned the fact that it took his wife approximately 45 minutes merely to make a reservation for the limousine bus.
The wife initially attempted to make the reservation herself but was unable to complete it,  so the Concierge assisted her.
Eventually,  the reservation was successfully completed when the Concierge made the booking on her behalf.
The guest stated that if this was possible,  it should have been done from the beginning,  and that his time was wasted unnecessarily.

Additionally,  the guest asked a nearby male staff member,  “Are you the person in charge?”
The staff member replied only that “The person in charge is a male staff member at the front desk.”

During the complaint,  the guest became quite agitated.
He stated that although there were existing issues between Japan and China during the daytime,  those matters were unrelated to him personally.
However,  he questioned whether this situation constituted racial discrimination against Chinese guests.

I offered a sincere apology to the guest and explained that our staff had absolutely no discriminatory intent.
I acknowledged that we had not been considerate enough toward the guest,  nor toward each other as staff members,  and that we failed to act with sufficient initiative and flexibility.
The guest appeared to understand this explanation.

The guest requested to speak with the General Manager,  but I informed him that this matter would be handled by the Front Desk and Concierge team.
As the guest was scheduled to check out at 9:00 a.m. the following morning,  it was agreed that he would speak again with the staff in charge at that time,  and the discussion concluded.

Afterward,  I confirmed the situation with the staff involved.
Including the time spent explaining how to make the limousine bus reservation,  the total time was just under 40 minutes.
Initially,  in accordance with regulations,  the guest was asked to make the reservation herself.
However,  her credit card was not easily authorized,  which caused delays.

At that point,  the husband arrived and asked,  “What happens if we pay in cash?”
Staff responded in accordance with regulations,  explaining that payment could be made at Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal.
Ultimately,  when the Concierge made the reservation on the guest’s behalf,  the earlier guidance to go to Shinjuku Expressway Bus Terminal was perceived by the guest as discriminatory.  1/3 Saigo
rows.Feedback Remarks 1:
ロビーコンシェルジュのサービスについて至らぬ点があったことに対する謝罪をし、受け入れていただきました。9時30分の成田空港行きリムジンバスを利用予定であったため、お見送り済。 1/4 祝園

We apologized for the shortcomings in the service provided by the lobby concierge, and the apology was accepted. As the guest was scheduled to take the 9:30 AM limousine bus to Narita Airport, we had already seen them off. 1/4　Iwaizono

rows.Incident Description:
Complain about World of Hyatt Status & Milestone Award. 
ワールドオブハイアットのステータスとマイルストーンアワードに関してクレーム。
rows.Incident Location: フロントレセプションカウンター 2F  Front Reception Counter
rows.Subject: #2020 Mr. Khurana, Rajkaran 1/7out
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
On 3 January 2026,  Guest Relations received multiple email communications from Mr. Karan Khurana expressing dissatisfaction with the handling of his World of Hyatt Globalist status and milestone awards.
During calendar year 2025,  Mr. Khurana completed 58 qualifying nights. He booked a stay at Hyatt Regency Tokyo from 29 December 2025 to 1 January 2026,  assuming that this stay would allow him to reach 60 qualifying nights for 2025 and therefore he will be qualify for the associated Globalist milestone benefits.
However,  in accordance with World of Hyatt program rules,  the stay was credited to calendar year 2026,  as the check-out date fell on 1 January 2026,  and therefore did not count toward 2025 qualification.
Mr. Khurana expressed strong dissatisfaction with the Global Care Center’s decision not to reinstate milestone awards,  stating that he had requested his reservation to be split upon check-in during a prior stay to ensure correct night allocation across calendar years.
The Hyatt Global Care Center confirmed the following:
Mr. Khurana’s Globalist status was exceptionally extended through February 2027 as a goodwill consideration.
No milestone awards will be issued,  in line with program policy,  despite reconsideration.
Guest Relations (Ms. Subin Choi) communicated this outcome to the guest,  explained the applicable policy constraints,  and offered support ahead of his upcoming stay.
Mr. Khurana subsequently advised via email that he had contacted Hyatt CEO Mr. Mark Hoplamazian. He also requested to meet with the General Manager upon check-in on 4 January,  stating that he considers the issue to be the hotel’s responsibility.
On 4 January,  the guest arrived and reiterated strong complaints at check-in,  blaming the hotel for not receiving the milestone award. SR.FOM met with the guest,  and advised that we would be reconfirmed with the Global Care Center and get back to him. A follow-up email was sent to the Global Care Center for clarification,  and the outcome will be shared with the guest once received. 1/4 Drici

1/3 こちらのGSTからGR宛にWorld of Hyatt Globalist ステータスとマイルストーンの取り扱いに関して複数の不満を示すメールあり。
2025年中に、GSTは58泊宿泊した。2025年12月29日から2026年1月1日までHRTに宿泊した。GSTがグローバリストになるためには12/29-2泊のステイカウントが必要だったため、この宿泊の結果、マイルストーン特典を受け取れると考えていた。しかし、World of Hyatt規約に基づき、1/1チェックアウトだったため、この宿泊は2026年のステイカウントにカウントされ、2025年にはカウントされなかった。
GSTはGCCがマイルストーンを発行しなかったことに強い不満を示し、到着時に予約を分割するよう依頼したことがあったため、2泊のステイカウントは2025年に換算されると考えていたようだった。
GCCと再度確認したが、GSTのGlobalist ステータスは2027年2月まで特別に延長されたが、ポリシーに従い、マイルストーン賞は再発行されませんでした。
GRのチェさんはこの結果と適用されるポリシーについて説明したメールを送り、次回の宿泊に向けてサポートを提供した。
その後、GSTはメールでハイアットCEOのマーク・ホプラマジアン氏に連絡したと言及し、1/4チェックイン時にGMとの面会を希望した。GSTは、ホテル側に責任があると考えていると述べた。

1/4到着時、GSTは再度強い不満を表明しました。アブデル課長が対応し、ホテル側からGCCに確認し、回答を得た後結果を伝えると約束した。 1/4 アブデル課長(代筆丹羽)

Fire breaks out at Nadaman Kitchen on the 3rd floor

rows.Source of Complaint: Reported by a Colleague スタッフからの報告

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/7 14:30頃 3F なだ万厨房で火災発生。初期消火に成功し、消火後に警察・消防が到着。現場検証を行った。

14:33 厨房の熱感知器が発報。警備隊が現場に急行し、コンロの鍋から火が上がっているのを確認。厨房内の消火器で消火した。
14:38 防災センターからDMに報告があり、佐藤も現場に急行。3F H2ホールも煙が溜まっている状態で、厨房内はさらに煙が充満している状況であった。同時に防災担当　今枝氏の指示で防災センターから119番通報。排煙装置を起動し、充満していた煙を排出。
14:52 東京消防庁から消防隊が正面玄関に到着。
14:56 消防隊が現場に到着。
15:10 新宿警察署から警察官2名が来館
16:19 すべての現場検証が終了

出火当時お客様はおらず、けが人もなし。
なだ万は本日のディナータイムから営業できる見通し。

1/7 Around 14:30 Fire broke out in the Nadaman kitchen on the 3rd floor. Initial firefighting efforts were successful. Police and fire department arrived after extinguishing the fire and conducted an on-site investigation.

14:33 The kitchen's heat detector activated. Security personnel rushed to the scene and confirmed flames rising from a pot on the stove. The fire was extinguished using a fire extinguisher inside the kitchen.
14:38 The Disaster Prevention Center reported the incident to DM,  and Sato also rushed to the scene. Smoke had accumulated in the 3F H2 Hall,  and the kitchen interior was even more heavily filled with smoke. Simultaneously,  following instructions from Disaster Prevention Officer Imabashi,  the Disaster Prevention Center called 119. The smoke exhaust system was activated to vent the accumulated smoke.
14:52 Firefighters from the Tokyo Fire Department arrived at the main entrance.
14:56 Firefighters arrived at the scene.
15:10 Two police officers from Shinjuku Police Station arrived at the scene.
16:19 All on-site investigations concluded.

No customers were present at the time of the fire,  and there were no injuries.
Nadaman is expected to be able to open for dinner service today.
rows.Feedback Remarks 1:
クローズします
以降は総務課案件となります　佐藤

3階「なだ万」での火災報知器の発報で館内全ての電子錠が一斉解除され、その後、防災センターにて通常の状態に戻しましたが、9階RCLの事務所・パントリーの電子錠が施錠されていないことがスタッフからの報告により判明いたしました。
9階RCLにある操作盤と防災センターの操作盤共に、トライするもエラー表示が出てしまい施錠ができない状態となってしまったため、1/8に施設課を通じて修理依頼予定。それまでは誰もが立ち入れる状況にあるため、部屋の照明は使用しない場合は、常に消灯の状態とし、スタッフ間で注視してまいります。1/7 RCL中村
A fire alarm activation on the 3rd floor at 'Nadaman' triggered the simultaneous release of all electronic locks throughout the building. Although the Disaster Prevention Centre subsequently restored normal operation,  staff reports indicated that the electronic locks for the 9th floor RCL office and pantry remained unlocked.
Attempts to lock them via both the control panel on the 9th floor RCL and the control panel at the Disaster Prevention Centre resulted in error messages,  rendering locking impossible. A repair request is scheduled for 8 January via the Facilities Department. Until then,  as the area remains accessible to anyone,  the room lighting must remain switched off when not in use,  and staff will maintain vigilance. 1/7 RCL Nakamura

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
9階RCLのカクテルタイムの営業開始後、カウンターのスタッフよりKPCの情報が読み込めないと入電あり。（ゲストの情報を読み取りアクセスが付いているかを確認することができない。）
情報システムに対応をお願いし、KPCのサポートセンターと共に調整を試みたが、カクテルタイム終了までに復旧することはできなかった。
引き続き、情報システムに復旧に向けて対応をお願いした。
そのため、今回はKPCを使用せず、OPERA端末にてゲストの情報を都度確認し、ラウンジ内にお通しした。
9階で使用しているKPCはレポート作成機能を有していないため、何かあった際にログを追うことができないといった懸念点があるため、その部分についても調整していきたい。1/8 中村
Following the commencement of cocktail hour operations at RCL on the 9th floor,  a call was received from counter staff reporting that KPC information could not be read. (It was impossible to read guest information and verify whether they had access.)
We requested assistance from the Information Systems department and attempted coordination with the KPC support centre,  but the issue could not be resolved before the end of cocktail hour.
We continued to request the Information Systems team to work towards restoring the system.
Consequently,  KPC was not used this time. Instead,  guest information was verified individually via the OPERA terminal before granting access to the lounge.
The KPC system used on the 9th floor lacks a report generation function. This raises concerns about the inability to trace logs should any issues arise. We intend to address this aspect as well.1/8 Nakamura

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/8 15:30頃ルームキーが見当たらない、レストランのスタッフに盗まれたとゲストが主張。
NineteenEighty有賀MGRがゲストと話すももっと上の立場の責任者と話をしたい、との事でコンシェルジュ岩田DMが対応。
テーブルに鍵を置いたが、コーヒーを下げる際に一緒に鍵を持っていかれたと主張されたため、念の為接客したスタッフに確認をし、テーブルの上にはコーヒーカップ以外何も置かれていなかったと確認。
GSTにも上記を説明の上、新しい鍵を提供できる旨を案内するも盗まれたことが問題だ、との事で監視カメラを確認。
監視カメラを確認した所、着席してからテーブル上に物を置いた様子が見られず、スタッフの不自然な動きがみられなかった状況を説明。
あたらめてゲストのポケットや財布の中に鍵が無いか確認を依頼した所、ポケットの中から鍵を発見し対応終了。　1/8　石田

Around 3:30 PM on January 8,  the guest reported that their room key was missing and claimed that it had been stolen by restaurant staff.
Mr. Ariga,  Manager at NineteenEighty,  spoke with the guest,  but the guest requested to speak with someone in a higher position,  so Concierge Duty Manager Mr. Iwata took over the situation.
The guest stated that they had placed the key on the table,  and that it must have been taken away together with the coffee cup when the coffee was cleared. As a precaution,  the staff member who served the table was asked to confirm,  and it was verified that there had been nothing on the table other than the coffee cup.
After explaining this to the guest,  we informed them that we could provide a new key; however,  the guest insisted that the issue was that the key had been stolen,  and requested that the security camera footage be checked.
Upon reviewing the surveillance footage,  there was no sign of the guest placing any items on the table after being seated,  nor were there any suspicious actions observed from the staff. This was explained to the guest.
We then asked the guest once again to check their pockets and wallet. The key was subsequently found in the guest’s pocket,  and the matter was resolved.

January 8
Ishida

rows.Incident Description:
腹痛、嘔吐、血便、めまいにより救急搬送
Transported to the emergency department due to abdominal pain, vomiting, bloody stool, and dizziness.
rows.Subject: 1926 | Ms. Jing Wang | FO Guest Sickness / Injury 宿泊ゲスト病気/けが
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Guest Sickness / Injury 宿泊ゲスト病気/けが
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/9 7:15頃、ISC経由で体調不良のため救急車を呼んで欲しいと依頼の入電あり。
電話だとわかりにくい部分もあり、一度部屋に伺い、容態を確認。症状として、夜中の3時ごろから血便が止まらない、嘔吐、下腹部の痛み、めまいがあるとのこと。顔面蒼白でベッドから動けない状態だったため、直ぐに救急車を防災経由で手配。
7:40頃、西新宿第一救急隊到着。8:10頃、山手メディカルセンターに搬送。 病名等詳細はまだ不明。ゲストに帰館後、DMにコンタクトしてと伝えられていないので、MSG付けております。P/up後、容態確認&インシデントレポート更新予定。1/9　岩田

At approximately 7:15 a.m. on January 9,  we received a call via ISC requesting that an ambulance be called due to the guest feeling unwell.
As it was difficult to fully understand the situation over the phone,  we went to the guest’s room to assess the condition in person.
The guest reported continuous bloody stools since around 3:00 a.m.,  along with vomiting,  lower abdominal pain,  and dizziness. The guest was pale and unable to get out of bed,  so an ambulance was immediately arranged through the Disaster Prevention team.
At approximately 7:40 a.m.,  the Nishi-Shinjuku Daiichi Emergency Team arrived,  and at around 8:10 a.m.,  the guest was transported to Yamate Medical Center. Details such as the diagnosis are still unknown.
We were not instructed to contact the DM after the guest returns to the hotel,  so we are leaving this message.
After pick-up,  we will check the guest’s condition and update the incident report accordingly.　Jan 9 Iwata

1/11 追記
OUT時改めてお声がけ。救急搬送時よりだいぶ体調も良くなったと申告あり。感謝の言葉を頂き見送り。　1/11　石田

Addendum (1/11)
Spoke with the patient again at checkout. The patient reported that their condition had improved significantly compared to when they were transported by ambulance. Received words of gratitude and saw them off.　1/11 Ishida

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
お預かりしたノートパソコンの破損に関するクレームについて

発生日時
1月12日　10:45頃

概要
1月12日10:45頃、ゲストよりデューティーマネジャー宛に電話連絡があり、前日にルームチェンジの際、コンシェルジュへ預けたノートパソコンについて、返却時に画面に傷があり液晶が正常に表示されないとの申し出があった。
ゲストによると、最後に使用した際は正常に作動しており、荷物移動時に損傷した可能性があるのではないかとのこと。まずはシドニーのアップル社に持ち込み修理を行い、仮に衝撃による破損と判断された場合は補償を求めたいとの意向であった。
当該連絡を受け、祝園が客室を訪問し、ノートパソコンの状態を確認（別途画像あり）。あわせて祝園の名刺をお渡し済み。
ゲストは終始冷静であり、強いお怒りの様子はなく、「保険で修理できれば一番良いよね」との発言があった。

念のため、荷物の取り扱い状況を確認するため、防犯カメラ映像を確認したところ、以下の動きが確認された。
10:18　ゲストが自身で荷物を持ち、客室823号室を退室
10:22　ゲスト自身がコンシェルジュデスクへ荷物を持参
10:27　コンシェルジュスタッフが預かった荷物を荷物保管スペースへ移動
　※カバン類はすべてスーツケースの上に置かれており、引きずる、乱暴に扱う等の行為は確認されず
13:39　コンシェルジュスタッフが荷物を荷物保管庫から台車へ移動
　※カバンを投げる等の不適切な取り扱いは確認されず
13:45　台車にて荷物を客室2021号室へ搬送
　※終始、丁寧に取り扱われており、不適切な行為は確認されず

今後の対応
防犯カメラ映像および確認できる範囲において、荷物を取り扱ったコンシェルジュスタッフによる過失は認められなかった。
今後はゲストとメールでのやり取りを継続予定であるが、仮に補償の要望があった場合でも、現時点ではホテル側の過失が確認できないため、補償には応じかねる旨を丁寧に説明する予定。
1/12 祝園
↓
現時点でゲストより連絡なし。 1/19 岩田
↓
ゲストより「パソコンは保険で修理できた」と報告あり。また、ご息女が現在日本におり、帰国前に体調を崩したため、2月の11日から12日までHRTにご滞在されるとのこと。引き続きGood Careでお願いします。 2/9 祝園

Complaint Regarding Damage to a Laptop Entrusted to the Hotel


January 12,  at approximately 10:45 a.m.
At approximately 10:45 a.m. on January 12,  a call was received by the Duty Manager from the guest regarding a laptop that had been entrusted to the Concierge during a room change on the previous day. The guest stated that upon return,  the laptop screen was found to be scratched and the display was not functioning properly.
According to the guest,  the laptop had been operating normally the last time it was used,  and the guest expressed concern that it may have been damaged during the transfer of luggage. The guest indicated that they would first take the laptop to Apple in Sydney for inspection and repair,  and that if the damage were determined to have been caused by impact,  they would request compensation.

Following the call,  I visited the guest room and confirmed the condition of the laptop (photos taken separately). My card was also provided to the guest.

Throughout the interaction,  the guest remained calm and did not appear particularly upset,  commenting that “it would be best if it could be repaired through insurance.”

As a precaution,  security camera footage was reviewed to confirm how the luggage was handled. The following movements were observed:
10:18 – The guest personally carried their luggage and exited Room 823.
10:22 – The guest personally brought the luggage to the Concierge desk.
10:27 – Concierge staff moved the entrusted luggage to the luggage storage area.
               All bags were placed on top of the suitcase,  and no dragging or careless handling was observed.
13:39 – Concierge staff moved the luggage from the storage area onto a trolley.
               No inappropriate handling,  such as throwing bags,  was observed.
13:45 – The luggage was transported by trolley to Room 2021.
              The luggage was handled carefully throughout,  and no improper actions were observed.

Based on the review of the security camera footage and the information available at this time,  no negligence on the part of the Concierge staff in handling the luggage has been identified.
Communication with the guest will continue via email. Should a request for compensation be made,  we plan to explain politely that,  as no fault on the part of the hotel has been confirmed at this stage,  we are unable to offer compensation at this time.
1/12 Iwaizono
↓
As of now,  we have not received any communication from the guest. 1/19 Iwata
↓
We have received an update from the guest that the computer was successfully repaired through insurance.
In addition,  the guest’s daughter is currently in Japan and has fallen ill prior to her return home. She will be staying with us from February 11 to February 12.
We kindly ask for your continued good care and support during her stay. 2/9 祝園

ゲストが預けていた荷物数点を引き取りに来館した際、スタッフが荷物保管庫からそのうちの一点である黒色のバックパックをコンシェルジュデスク上に置いたが、ゲストは当該荷物を受け取らないまま退館した。

防犯カメラ映像の確認結果により、当方に過失はないと判断した。 (画像参照）

2026/1/20　09：00頃

I was informed by DM Mizutani that a guest had been bitten by insects in the room and was requesting ice.
I visited the guest room together with DM Mizutani.
After confirming the situation,  a female guest came out. Marks consistent with insect bites were observed on the top of her foot and on her arm,  as well as a rash-like mark on her face (right cheek).
Ice was provided to the guest,  and we advised her to contact us if she required any further assistance. The initial response was then concluded.
Subsequently,  a request was received to change the bed sheets,  and the linens were replaced accordingly.　　　-HK Nakano

January 20,  2026

January 21,  2026

January 25,  2026

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/21 10:00頃、GST立ち寄りあり。1/20のｽﾃｲﾒｲｸ後にｼｬﾜｰのところにIN時にはなかったﾘｯﾌﾟﾊﾞｰﾑのﾁｭｰﾌﾞがあった。GSTはﾎﾃﾙのｱﾒﾆﾃｨだと思ったので使用したと申告あり。あいにくﾎﾃﾙのｱﾒﾆﾃｨではないため、客室課にて調査して結果を連絡させて欲しいと伝え済。GSTへの連絡は外出されるため分かり次第登録の電話(65 81182787)に希望。唇につけるものだし、衛生面も発生した理由も知りたいと不安を感じていた。

1/21 11：00  調査の結果、昨日の客室清掃中にメイドが洗面台下で見つけ、このGST私物と誤認しカウンターに戻したことが判明。ご説明とお詫びの為、何度か電話かけるも繋がらず。登録のアドレスにお詫びのメールを送り、お部屋にメッセージを点けコンタクトを取る予定。　HK岩谷

1/21 16:30にゲストがホテルへ戻られたため、客室へ伺い、今回の件について経緯説明と謝罪を行った。
その際、何かお詫びとして対応できることはないか確認したが、ゲストからは「何もいらない」と強く辞退された。
ただし、「今後二度と同じことが起こらないように約束してほしい」と要望があり、再発防止を約束した。
チェックアウト時にも、改めて謝罪を行う予定である。HK岩谷

1/22 13：37 アウト時再度客室よりお詫びに向かったが、昨日お詫びしてもらったのでもういい。とおっしゃられチェックアウトされた。F石田-HK岩谷

1/21 10:00
The guest stopped by the front desk. The guest reported that after the stay-over room cleaning on January 20,  a lip balm tube that had not been present at the time of check-in was found near the shower area. The guest stated that they used the lip balm,  believing it to be a hotel amenity.

As the item is not a hotel amenity,  the guest was informed that the Housekeeping Department would investigate the matter and follow up with the results. As the guest was going out,  they requested to be contacted at the registered phone number (65 8118 2787) once the investigation was completed. The guest expressed concern regarding hygiene,  as the item was applied to the lips,  and wished to understand how this situation had occurred.

1/21 11:00
Following an investigation,  it was confirmed that during room cleaning the previous day,  a housekeeping attendant found the item under the sink and mistakenly identified it as the guest’s personal belonging,  returning it to the bathroom counter.

Several attempts were made to contact the guest by phone to explain the situation and offer an apology; however,  the calls were unsuccessful. An apology email was sent to the guest’s registered email address,  and a message will be placed in the guest room in order to establish contact.  HK iwatani

1/21 16:30
As the guest had returned to the hotel,  we visited the room to explain the situation and offer our sincere apologies. We also asked if there was anything we could do as a gesture of apology; however,  the guest firmly declined and stated that no compensation was necessary.
The guest requested that we ensure such an incident would never happen again. We assured them that we would take all necessary measures to prevent a recurrence.I plan to extend our apologies once again at the time of check-out. HKiwatani

1/22　13：37 At check-out,  we attempted to apologize again,  but the guest said an apology had already been given the previous day and checked out. F ishida-HK iwatani

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
<8歳のご子息様が体調不良と連絡受け>
3日ほど前からのどの痛み・腹痛(一番ひどい)・咳・熱・下痢の症状があり、往診希望。Dr.佐々江の携帯(070-4483-3123)に架電するも電源OFF。DMとReceptionをCCにしてﾒｰﾙしてます。GSTに現時点で連絡がついていない旨伝え済。救急車を手配するかｸﾘﾆｯｸに来院するか希望を伺いましたが、一旦ｵﾝﾗｲﾝ診察をご自身で探してみるとのこと。こちらもDr.佐々江から返信が来たらお部屋に電話すると伝え済。 1/22 丹羽

返信あり。ご自身でｵﾝﾗｲﾝ診療予約したが直接Drが来るならそっちの方がいい、との事で1/22 18:00 Dr.佐々江来館依頼済。　1/22　石田

1/22 18:50
Dr.佐々江到着。往診の結果インフルエンザA型だった。兄も体調不良とのことで検診したところ同じインフルエンザA型であることが判明した。 1/22 19:50 西郷

The child has been experiencing symptoms for approximately three days,  including sore throat,  abdominal pain (most severe),  cough,  fever,  and diarrhea,  and requested a house call.
We attempted to contact Dr. Sasae via mobile phone (070-4483-3123),  but the phone was switched off. An email was sent with DM and Reception in CC.
The guest was informed that we have not been able to reach the doctor at this time.
We asked whether they would prefer us to arrange an ambulance or for them to visit a clinic; however,  the guest indicated that they would first try to find an online consultation on their own.
We also informed the guest that we would call the room as soon as we receive a response from Dr. Sasae.　1/22　Niwa

We received a notification that the guest’s 8-year-old son was unwell.
A reply was received from the guest. The guest had made an appointment for an online medical consultation on their own; however,  they stated that they would prefer an in-person visit if a doctor could come directly. Accordingly,  a request was made for Dr. Sasae to visit the hotel at 18:00 on January 22. 1/22 Ishida

1/22 18:50
Dr. Sasae arrived. As a result of the house call examination,  the patient was diagnosed with Influenza A. The older brother was also feeling unwell,  and after being examined,  he was likewise found to have Influenza A.  1/22 19:50 Saigo

rows.Incident Item Name: Police matters 警察案件
rows.Subject: 4階オブジェ盗難事案/Object stolen from the 4th floor
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: Police matters 警察案件
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
8:00頃、防災センタースタッフが7時に4階の巡回時に、設置されているオブジェのひとつが無くなっていることに気づきDMコール。
客室課や施設課で修繕依頼を出していなかったため防犯カメラを確認したところ、早朝5時台に不審な人物を映像で確認。 

詳細な人物の動きは以下の通り。 

5:13 
TAXIで正面玄関に到着。館内に入る。 
*東京無線18-37と思われる 

5:14 
EV11号機（駐車場行）に乗り全てのボタンを押す。B2、B３で一度降り、フロアに何もないことを確認。再度11号機に乗る。 

5:17 
4階で降り、EV横にある絵画に手をかけ外そうとする。
 *オブジェがある通路は防犯カメラ無し 

5:21 
多目的用トイレを左に進み、12号機で26F＆28Fへ。 *上記フロアでは降りずに2Fへ 

5:24 
2F降車。社内ポストを右折しゲスト用荷物保管エリアを直進。 

5:26 
TAXI乗り場前の従業員通用口から外へ出ようと試みるも自動ドアの電源を切っているため開かず。 周辺の色々なボタンを押し始める。
 *この時点で男のカバンから4Fオブジェの一部が見える 

5:27 
手動で従業員通用口を開け、そのまま駐車しているタクシーに乗りヒルトン方面へ。 
*個人タクシー練馬6-36と思われる 

今後は防犯の観点から翌朝のドアマン勤務が始まる7時までストレージルームを施錠することとする。

事柄は総務課へ報告済。

総務部村上部長より、新宿警察へ被害届を提出し、受理。現在捜査中のため、進展あればアップデートいたしますが、いったんクローズします。4/13/2026　戸部

At approximately 8:00,  the Disaster Prevention Center staff reported that during their 7:00patrol on the 4th floor,  they noticed that one of the installed objects was missing,  and a Duty Manager call was made.

As neither the House Keeping Department nor the Engineering Department had submitted any repair or removal requests,  security camera footage was reviewed. As a result,  a suspicious individual was observed on video in the early morning around 5:00 a.m.

The detailed movements of the individual are as follows:

5:13
Arrived at the main entrance by taxi and entered the building.
Believed to be Tokyo Musen taxi No. 18-37

5:14
Boarded Elevator No. 11 and pressed all floor buttons.
Exited once at B2 and B3,  confirmed that there was nothing on those floors,  then re-boarded Elevator No. 11.

5:17
Exited on the 4th floor and attempted to remove a picture located next to the elevator.
*There are no security cameras in the corridor where the object is installed.

5:21
Proceeded left past the multipurpose restroom,  then boarded Elevator No. 12 and went to 26F and 28F.
*He did not get off either floor and continued down to 2F.

5:24
Exited on 2F,  turned right at the internal mail box area,  and walked straight through the guest luggage storage area.

5:26
Attempted to exit through the employee entrance near the taxi stand,  but the automatic door did not open as the power was turned off.
Began pressing various buttons around the sliding door.
At this point,  part of the 4th-floor object could be seen inside his bag.

5:27
Manually opened the employee entrance door and boarded a parked taxi,  departing in the direction of Hilton.
*Believed to be a private taxi,  Nerima 6-36.

Going forward,  for security reasons,  the storage room will be kept locked until the doorman’s shift begins at 7:00 a.m. the following morning.

The incident has been reported to the General Affairs Department.

A report was filed with the Shinjuku Police by Mr. Murakami,  Director of the General Affairs Department,  and has been accepted. As the case is currently under investigation,  we will provide updates if there are any developments; however,  this report will be closed for the time being.April 13,  2026
Tobe

rows.Incident Description:
荷物引き取りの際、荷物を探すのに時間を要し苦言。その他サービスについても苦言あり。 1/24 岩田

During baggage pickup, it took a considerable amount of time to locate the luggage, which led to a complaint. There were also complaints regarding other aspects of the service. 1/24 Iwata
rows.Subject: 0728 | Ms. Ayako Kawano | FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
17:30頃、チェックアウト後に預けた荷物を引き取りにゲストが帰館。
預かりタグを受け取ったスタッフが荷物を捜索するも該当の荷物を見つからず、時間を要してしまう。
なかなか発見に至らない状態が続いたため、別のスタッフが対応を代わり、ゲストに荷物の個数・形状を確認。その際、なぜそんなに時間がかかるのかと既にご立腹。
再度、荷物を捜索している最中、ゲストが突如荷捌き室に侵入し、これが私の荷物だ、と指差し。その時点で相当ご立腹であり、荷物を探してたスタッフに対して、あなたはアルバイトなのか、へらへらしている態度が気に食わないなど、強い口調で仰る。
コンシェルジュのインチャージが対応を代わり、時間を要しご不便をおかけしたことに対し謝罪。
話を伺う中で、今回の荷物対応だけではなく、チェックインおよびチェックアウトの際の対応も悪い、また朝食利用時、若いスタッフが叱責されているような場面を目撃した。ゲストの前でやることではない。等サービス全般に対して苦言。それらについてGCCに苦言のメールを送りたいと申告があった為、GCCとホテルの代表のメールアドレスを渡し済み。
最終的に口調は落ち着いたが、あきれているような感じであった。
出発の際お見送りを試みたが、別件で席を外した時にゲストは既に出発されており見送りはできず。 1/24 岩田
↓
1/25 20：37 GSTからコンプレメールを受信。
メールにはチェックアウト時の対応と荷物受け取りの対応に関して苦言が記載されていた。1/26田中
↓
戸部よりゲストあてにお詫びのメールを1/26に送信した。GCCにも同じ内容でコンプレインがあったが、GCCにはすでにこちらで対応中と報告した。1/27　戸部　

At approximately 5:30 p.m.,  the guest returned to the hotel to retrieve luggage that had been stored after check-out.
The staff member who received the claim tag searched for the luggage; however,  the item could not be located immediately,  resulting in a delay.
As the situation continued without resolution,  another staff member took over and confirmed the number and description of the luggage with the guest. At that point,  the guest was already upset and questioned why it was taking so long.
While the luggage search was ongoing,  the guest suddenly entered the luggage handling area and pointed out a bag,  stating,  “This is my luggage.” The guest was visibly very upset and spoke in a strong tone to the staff member who had been searching,  making remarks such as asking whether the staff member was a part-time employee and expressing dissatisfaction with what was perceived as an inappropriate attitude.
The concierge in charge then took over the situation and apologized for the inconvenience caused by the delay in locating the luggage.
During the conversation,  the guest expressed complaints not only about the luggage handling but also about the quality of service during check-in and check-out. In addition,  the guest mentioned witnessing a young staff member being reprimanded during breakfast service,  stating that such behavior should not take place in front of guests. Overall,  the guest voiced dissatisfaction with the service provided.
The guest requested to send a complaint email to GCC,  and therefore,  the email addresses of GCC and the hotel representative were provided.
Although the guest’s tone eventually became calmer,  they appeared to remain dissatisfied.
An attempt was made to see the guest off at departure; however,  while stepping away briefly for another matter,  the guest had already departed,  and we were unable to provide a send-off. 1/24 Iwata 
↓
1/25 20:37 Received a complaint email from GST.
The email contained criticism regarding the handling at checkout and the handling of luggage collection.1/26 Tanaka
↓
An apology email was sent to the guest by Tobe on January 26. The same complaint was also received by the Global Care Center; however,  GCC was informed that the matter was already being handled by our team.
January 27 – Tobe

rows.Subject: Others | N/A N/A | Police matters 警察案件
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: Police matters 警察案件
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
1/25 1:25頃、セブンイレブンにおいて、買い物もせず、本の立ち読みをし長時間店内に滞在しているお客様がおり、（言動・風貌も少しおかしい）本の立ち読み・長時間滞在できない旨を伝えた上で退去をお願いをしたが、応じてもらえないので警察を呼んでほしいとセブンイレブンのスタッフより依頼があり、防災から警察出動の要請をした。

同日1:35頃、防災にて警察に連絡。
同日1:50頃、警察官2名到着。

警察官2名が退館するように促すが、始発まで待ちたいとそれを拒否。何度も長時間の滞在は店舗に迷惑がかかると繰り返し説明をするが納得せず。所々、言動がおかしく、店員が私のことを嫌っている・SNSで悪口を言われているなど等の発言。
2:11頃、埒が明かないことにしびれを切らした警察官が力ずくでお客様を店外へ連れ出す。
その後、1:19頃、敷地外まで誘導し、対応終了。 1/25 岩田

At approximately 1:25 a.m. on January 25,  at a Seven-Eleven store,  there was a customer who remained in the store for an extended period of time reading books without making any purchases. The customer’s behavior and appearance were observed to be somewhat unusual. After being informed that reading books in the store and prolonged stays were not permitted,  the customer was asked to leave; however,  the request was refused. As a result,  Seven-Eleven staff requested that the police be called,  and the Disaster Prevention team requested police assistance.

At approximately 1:35 a.m. on the same day,  the Disaster Prevention team contacted the police.
At approximately 1:50 a.m.,  two police officers arrived on site.

The two police officers asked the customer to leave the premises; however,  the customer refused,  stating that he wished to wait until the first train. Despite repeated explanations that prolonged stays caused inconvenience to the store,  the customer did not accept this explanation. During the interaction,  the customer made several unusual remarks,  including statements such as believing that store staff disliked him and that he was being spoken ill of on social media.
At approximately 2:11 a.m.,  as the situation could not be resolved through discussion,  the police officers escorted the customer out of the store by force. The customer was then guided off the premises,  and the matter was concluded. 1/25 Iwata
rows.Feedback Remarks 1: Case Close

体調は全く問題ないとのことでした。野菜の成長を見たりコントロールしたりできないため、どこでも起こりうると理解してくれており、ゲストもまったく気にしていない様子でしたので、今回の件はケースクローズといたします。
また、オレンジの状態については皮の部分の見た目についてはきれいであったため切ってみないと中身の状態までは分かりませんでした。恐らく、冷蔵保存の段階で、温度が引きすぎると稀に状態が悪くなることがあるとインターネットに書かれおりましたので、保存については今一度、しっかりと管理していただくようクリーンルームに依頼いたしました。1/25 RCL中村

During cocktail time,  a guest pointed out that the orange was rotten.
The guest stated that when they were about to take a second bite,  they noticed that the center of the orange was rotten.
We sincerely apologized to the guest.　1/24 Regency-Sekino

On the morning of 25th January,  as guests were present,  Section Chief Abdel and Nakamura apologised and checked on their wellbeing.
They confirmed they were perfectly fine. They understood that since vegetable growth cannot be observed or controlled,  such occurrences can happen anywhere,  and the guests did not seem concerned at all. Therefore,  we consider this matter closed.
Regarding the oranges,  the outer peel appeared clean,  so the internal condition could not be ascertained without cutting them open. We noted online references suggesting that,  rarely,  excessive cold during refrigerated storage can cause deterioration. Consequently,  we have requested the cleanroom to ensure storage conditions are thoroughly managed once more.1/25 RCL Nakamura

警備スタッフとともに警察を待ったが突然正面玄関から退館しタバコを吸い始めたため、敷地内は禁煙である旨通告したところ、タクシーに乗ろうとしたが、その時に警察が現着。1/26 4：50
↓
はじめに田中より警察に説明、その後男性の主張を警察に話す。
警察も男性を落ち着かせるように話をしたが、突然にハイアットリージェンシー東京に彼女が宿泊しているから連絡すると言い始める。その後しばらくして男性曰く彼女が現れそのままタクシーに乗車して退去。1/26 5：20

<警察が男性から聴取した内容>
宿泊中のお連れの人（彼女）と喧嘩をして酒を飲みそのままホテルにWalk Inにて現れたが断れた際のスタッフの態度とその後のDMの対応にムカついてしまったとのこと。

最終的にはﾎﾃﾙを退去したが、一連の流れから今後再度来館する可能性もあるため、防犯カメラより男性の写真を添付しています。フロント内にて共有。
特徴：金髪小柄男性上下黒い服装
↓
その後防犯カメラを確認したところ、件の女性は#2425(1/27OUT予定）のゲストと思われる。
（正面からの顔がパスポートの顔写真に酷似していたこと、使用している携帯電話が同じであったことから推察）
確証ではないためインシデントレポートにのみ残します。1/27 祝園

At 4:20 a.m.,  a man who appeared to be Chinese and spoke both Japanese and English arrived at the Walk In. Staff reported he was intoxicated,  reeked of alcohol,  and exhibited suspicious behavior and appearance. He was denied lodging,  but he refused to leave,  claiming dissatisfaction with the initial staff member's response. DM Tanaka requested he leave the premises,  but he complied. The incident was reported to the police via the Disaster Prevention Center. 1/26 4:38
↓
We waited with security staff for the police,  but he suddenly left through the main entrance and started smoking. We informed him the premises are non-smoking. He then attempted to get into a taxi,  at which point the police arrived. 1/26 4:50
↓
First,  Tanaka explained the situation to the police,  then relayed the man's account to them.
The police also tried to calm the man down,  but suddenly began saying he would contact girlfriend because she is staying at the Hyatt Regency Tokyo. Shortly after,  the man stated she appeared and immediately boarded a taxi to leave.1/26 5:20

<Statement taken by police from the man>
He stated that he had an argument with his companion (his girlfriend) ,  drank alcohol,  and then appear to walk in the hotel. He became angry at the staff's attitude when he was refused entry and their subsequent handling of the direct message.

He ultimately left the hotel,  but given the sequence of events,  there is a possibility he may return in the future. Therefore,  we are attaching a photo of the man taken from security cameras. Shared within the front desk.
Description: Blonde-haired,  petite male wearing all black clothing.
↓
After reviewing the security camera footage,  the woman is believed to be the guest in Room #2425 (scheduled to check out on January 27).
This assessment is based on the fact that her face,  seen from the front,  closely resembled the photo on the passport,  and that she was using the same mobile phone.
As this cannot be confirmed with certainty,  the information will be recorded in the incident report only.
January 27　Iwaizono

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
<歯科ｸﾘﾆｯｸ紹介した経緯有>
1/26 歯の被せ物が取れてしまったとのことで赤羽歯科 新宿診療所を紹介。
その後痛みがひどい為応急処置ではなく根本的な治療をして欲しいが、赤羽歯科では予約の空きが無いため別のｸﾘﾆｯｸを紹介して欲しいと立ち寄りあり。きくち歯科を1/27 12:15-予約をしています。　1/26　石田
↓
その後、もう少し早い時間帯での根幹治療をしてくれるところを希望。ササエ様に連絡し、紹介していただいたTokyo Clinic Dental Officeに連絡、Dr, ドレナンと話をするも「ここではダメだ」と仰る。結果、ご自身で探したさくらプラチナム歯科を希望。電話したがつながらず。「ではきくち歯科で良い」と最終的に落ち着いた。 1/27 祝園
↓
改めて、歯が痛むと問い合わせあり。
今日か明日いける根幹治療をおこなっている病院がいいとのことで英語対応の病院は1/28の枠は全て受付終了。
ラ・トゥール新宿歯科（https://shinjukudental.com/）であれば明日の朝から予約可能とのことだったので記録にのこします。
また、30日の15:40よりきくち歯科にて別途予約あり。 1/28 祝園

〈Background of Dental Clinic Referral〉
On 1/26,  the patient reported that a dental crown had come off,  so Akabane Dental Clinic (Shinjuku Branch) was introduced.
Later,  the patient returned requesting fundamental treatment rather than temporary pain relief due to severe pain. However,  because there were no available appointment slots at Akabane Dental Clinic,  the patient asked to be referred to another clinic.
An appointment has been scheduled at Kikuchi Dental Clinic for 1/27 from 12:15.
1/26 Ishida
↓
After that,  he hoped to find a clinic that could provide root canal treatment at an earlier time.
We contacted Dr. Sasae,  who introduced them to Tokyo Clinic Dental Office. We then contacted the clinic and spoke with Dr. Drennan,  but Mr. Cooper said,  “This cannot be done there.”

As a result,  he wished to go to Sakura Platinum Dental Clinic,  which he had found on his own. However,  when we called,  they were unable to get through.
Eventually,  Mr. Cooper settled on “Kikuchi Dental Clinic is fine.”

January 27 Iwaizono
↓
We received another inquiry from Mr. Cooper reporting tooth pain.
He requested a clinic that can perform root canal treatment either today or tomorrow. However,  all English-speaking clinics had fully booked appointments for 1/28.

La Tour Shinjuku Dental Clinic (https://shinjukudental.com/
) has availability starting tomorrow morning,  so this has been noted in the record.

Additionally,  there is a separate appointment scheduled at Kikuchi Dental Clinic on the 30th at 15:40.

1/28　Iwaizono

その際に女性が手を出してきたので、 Mr. Chenの被っていた帽子をはたきおとす形になった。

被害者であるMrs. JeonとMr. Chenは不審者に絡まれたものの、特に気にしませんと述べられた。。1/31 西郷

1/31 19:10

When the bus arrived and they attempted to board,  a suspicious Japanese woman,  appearing to be in her 50s or older and carrying a large amount of luggage,  suddenly appeared and confronted them,  telling them not to cut in line.
During the confrontation,  the woman acted aggressively and struck out with her hand,  which caused Mr. Chen’s hat to be knocked off.
The woman then shouted that they could call the police if they wanted,  but she did not board the bus and walked away.

rows.Incident Description:
RCLでの対応についてクレーム

Complaint regarding the handling at the RCL
rows.Subject: 2029 | Mr. Chao Xu | &  Mr. Wang Chen (Room 820)   Other Issue
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
Mr. Wang Chen (Room 820) approached the Regency Club Lounge with visible tattoos. The RCL team politely informed the guest that visible tattoos are not permitted in the lounge,  in accordance with hotel policy. Mr. Wang fully understood the explanation and confirmed that he would wear a long-sleeve shirt to comply with the policy.
Subsequently,  Mr. Xu Chao (Room 2029) requested to speak with a manager. Sr. FOM attended the discussion and explained the same policy. The main guest directly involved in the tattoo policy Mr. Wang Chen,  showed understanding and willingness to comply and communication was very smooth,  however,  Mr. Xu Chao requested to meet again after breakfast.
At approximately 11:15,  Mr. Xu Chao approached the Front Desk requesting further explanations and later requested compensation for himself. This request was politely declined.
Please note that Mr. Xu Chao does not have any tattoos,  was not approached by the Regency Club Lounge team,  and was not directly involved in the initial interaction. All communication regarding the tattoo policy was conducted with Mr. Wang Chen,  and those discussions were smooth and cooperative.
Mr. Xu Chao then requested to have breakfast at XRK instead of the Regency Club Lounge for his room. This request was also politely declined,  and Globalist benefits were clearly explained.
Following this,  Mr. Xu Chao raised additional concerns regarding:
The elevator not being key-secured and stating that he did not feel safe
A sharp edge in the bathroom
A room move was offered as a service recovery measure to prevent further dissatisfaction; however,  the guest declined the room change. He was asked whether there was any injury or need for medical assistance,  which he confirmed was not required as there was no injury.
Upon request,  a bath mat was placed immediately at the bathroom edge. Housekeeping was informed to note and follow the guest’s preference accordingly.
Current Status:
Hotel policy was clearly explained and acknowledged by the directly involved guest (Mr. Wang Chen) without issue
No exceptions or compensation were provided to Mr. Xu Chao,  as he was not directly involved in the policy enforcement

Mr.Wangは、視認できるタトゥーを見せた状態でリージェンシークラブラウンジにアプローチしました。RCLチームは、ホテルの方針に従い、視認できるタトゥーはラウンジ内では許可されていないことを丁寧にお伝えしました。Mr.Wangはその説明を十分に理解し、方針に従うために長袖のシャツを着ることを確認しました。

その後、Mr. Xu（ルーム2029）がマネージャーとの面会を希望しました。Sr. FOMがその対応を行い、同様の方針について説明しました。タトゥーに関する方針に直接関与しているMr.Wangは理解を示し、協力的な対応をしていただきましたが、Mr. Xuは朝食後に再度の面会を希望しました。

おおよそ11時15分に、Mr. Xuがフロントデスクに近づき、さらなる説明を求め、その後、自分自身への補償を要求しました。この要求は丁寧にお断りしました。

なお、Mr. Xuにはタトゥーはなく、リージェンシークラブラウンジのチームからアプローチもされておらず、最初のやり取りには直接関与していません。タトゥー方針に関するすべてのコミュニケーションはMr.Wangとの間で行われ、話し合いは円滑で協力的でした。

その後、Mr. Xuはルームの朝食をリージェンシークラブラウンジではなくXRKで提供してほしいとリクエストしました。この要求も丁寧にお断りし、グローバリスト特典について明確に説明しました。

その後、Mr. Xuは以下の追加的な懸念事項を挙げました：

エレベーターがキーで施錠されていないことについて、安全ではないと感じたこと

バスルームに鋭い縁があること
部屋の移動をサービス回復の手段として提案しましたが、ゲストは部屋の変更を辞退しました。怪我や医療支援が必要か尋ねたところ、怪我はないとのことで、医療支援も不要であると確認されました。

ご要望に応じて、バスルームの端にバスマットをすぐに配置しました。ハウスキーピングには、ゲストの好みに従って対応するよう伝えました。

現在の状況：

ホテルの方針は、直接関与したゲスト（Mr.Wang）に対して明確に説明され、問題なく理解されました。

Mr. Xuには方針の適用に直接関与していなかったため、例外や補償は提供されませんでした。

rows.Subject: 0823 | Ms. Kaori Kitajima | FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情　2/12OUT
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
15時頃チェックインの為に来館。停電作業の為部屋の用意が出来ておらず、ウェイティングルームを提案。1107にチェックイン。その際担当スタッフより17時には「絶対に」部屋が用意できると案内。
16:55頃フロントに再度立ち寄りあるもまだ用意が出来ず、フロントにて5分程お待ちいただく。
その際に以下の指摘あり。
①点検作業がある場合に事前に宿泊者に通知出来ないのか。
②最初に立ち寄った際に17:00には「絶対に」部屋の用意が出来る状態になっている、と言われたが出来ていなかった。ｻｰﾋﾞｽの場面にもよるが「絶対」という言葉は使うべきではない。
丁重にお詫びの上、対応したスタッフへの指導を行う旨をお伝えしています。
部屋自体はとても素敵な部屋で満足しています、ともお言葉をいただいています。OUT時改めてお声掛け予定　2/9　石田

At approximately 3:00 p.m.,  the guest arrived at the hotel to check in. Due to a scheduled power outage for maintenance work,  the room was not ready at that time,  and we offered the use of a waiting room. The guest checked in for 1107. At that time,  the staff informed the guest that the room would definitely be ready by 5:00 p.m.
At approximately 4:55 p.m.,  the guest contat at the front desk again; however,  the room was still not ready. The guest was asked to wait at the front desk for approximately five minutes.
During this time,  the guest raised the following concerns:
1. Whether it would be possible to notify guests in advance when inspection or maintenance work is scheduled.
2. The guest had been informed during the initial visit that the room would definitely be ready by 5:00 p.m.,  but this was not the case. Depending on the service situation,  the word “definitely” should not be used.
We offered a sincere apology and informed the guest that guidance and instruction would be provided to the staff member involved.
The guest also commented that the room itself was very nice and that they were satisfied with it. We plan to speak with the guest again at check-out.

February 9
Ishida

rows.Subject: #1819  | Mr. Kai Cheong Victor Ng | FO Other Issue フロントその他 2/17
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
①2月12日～1泊と②2/13日から4泊の2つに分かれた予約。①は2VDK（後から追加で入れた予約）　②は2VWK（当初の予約）。
ﾁｪｯｸｲﾝｸﾗｰｸから空き状況を調べた上で、同じお部屋にてご用意が出来ない為、ﾙｰﾑﾁｪﾝｼﾞを案内。その際。①と②の部屋の特徴を改装（フルリノベーションかソフトリノベーション）済かどうか含めて案内したが、下記の通りGSTが主張しMGR Callとなった。
〇公式サイトへどの部屋タイプがフルリノベーションでどの客室がソフトリノベーションなのか記載がない。
　→タブレットにて公式サイトの重要なお知らせから改装に関するページを見せたが、英語表記のページにおいては、表記が分かりづらいとのこと。
〇部屋タイプが異なる2つの予約があるのに到着前に確認の為の連絡が何もなかった。
　→すべてのお客様に対して事前にメールを差し上げることはないと丁重に説明。他のHyattのプロパティでは出来るのにここはできないのはおかしいとのコメント。
〇後から入れた予約に対して「部屋移動はしたくないから同じ部屋になるように配慮して欲しい」と備考欄に記載したが誰からも返事が来なかった。
　→お詫びをしつつも上記同様説明。
〇すべての事項を2/13朝一で上長へ報告してGSTへ代替案などをお話ししたい旨提案するも「あなたが今の時間帯の責任者なんだろ。今すぐ解決策を見出せ。」の一点張り。
　→再度部屋状況を確認して、2/13の2VDK予約をマイナスさせて、GSTに同じ部屋にて滞在出来る様に手配した。なお、②の4泊分の部屋代差額は徴収する旨案内し了承を得ています。

一連の流れに1時間超かけてしまったため、お詫びとして2/13の無料朝食を提案するも特別配慮は要らないと断られた。

MGRコールとなった際の私の対応の仕方次第ではここまで大きくはならなかったかもしれません。
最終的にGSTが望む形にはなったものの、「宿泊部長かGMから詫びのレターをよこせ」と言われています。　2/13田中
↓
戸部が直接ゲストにお会いし、お詫びしました。改めてお詫びのレターと共にコーテシーを入室します。　2/13　戸部

① A reservation split into two parts: ① February 12th for 1 night and ② February 13th for 4 nights. ① is a 2VDK (added later). ② is a 2VWK (original reservation).
After checking availability via OPERA,  we informed the guest that the same room type couldn't be provided and offered a room change. During this process,  we explained the characteristics of rooms ① and ②,  including whether they had done renovation (full or soft). However,  as detailed below,  the Guest  insisted on escalating the issue to the Duty Manager.
〇 The official website does not specify which room types have done full renovation and which have done soft renovation.
　→ We showed the renovation information page under Important Notices on the official website via tablet. However,  they stated the English-language page was unclear.
〇 Despite having two reservations for different room types,  there was no contact for confirmation prior to arrival.
　→ We politely explained that we do not proactively email all guests beforehand. Comment: It's strange that other Hyatt properties can do this but this one cannot.
〇 For a later reservation,  the guest noted in the remarks section,  “I don't want to change rooms,  so please arrange for the same room, ” but received no response.
　→ Apologized while providing the same explanation as above.
〇 Proposed reporting all issues to the supervisor first thing on 2/13 and discussing alternatives to the GST,  but “You're the person in charge right now. Find a solution immediately.”
　→ After reconfirming room availability,  I have gave 2VDK for the GST in the same room. I also informed them that the room rate difference for the four nights mentioned in point ② would be charged,  and they agreed.

As this entire process took over an hour,  I offered complimentary breakfast on February 13th as an apology,  but they declined,  stating no special consideration was needed.

Had I handled the situation differently when it escalated to a manager call,  it might not have become this significant.
Although we ultimately accommodated the GST's request,  they are demanding “an apology letter from the Directer of Rooms or General Manager.”
2/13 Tanaka
↓
Tobe met with the guest in person to offer a sincere apology. A formal apology letter will be delivered to the room along with a courtesy amenity.
2/13 Tobe

rows.Subject: 0736 | Mr. Akira Hayashi | FO Service Complaint フロントサービス苦情

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
2/14の早朝6:51amに林様から外線で電話があり、滞在中の不快な体験について苦言を呈され、ISCスタッフが10分ほど拘束された。
内容はリージェンシークラブラウンジのエッグステーションのスタッフについて(ベテラン風に見えたとのこと)、笑顔がない、林様が皿を受け取るときも無表情だった、これがこのホテルのポリシーなのか？というもの。
ゲストはスタッフの態度について改善を求めるとは言っていたものの、「ただ思ったことを伝えたかった」ということで折り返しの連絡は求められなかった。ISCスタッフからは「貴重なご意見ありがとうございます。上の者に申し伝えます。」とだけ伝え、終話した。
9FクラブラウンジでもGRスタッフに同じ話をしていた。チェックアウトはいつもEXP/OUTのため、OUT時の声掛けなどもできなかった。
林様は次回の予約が3/6に入っている。　ISC遠藤

次回5/15の予約あり。期間が経っているため、この件については触れないが、関係各署に周知し、グッドケアする予定。4/13/2026　戸部

ISC received a phone call from Lifetime Globalist Mr. Akira Hayashi,  who stayed with us from Feb 12th to 14th,   and he complained about their unpleasant experience during his stay.
ISC staff were detained for about 10 minutes. (It was early in the morning before the morning shift staff came,  so she couldn't answer even if other calls rings.)
As for the content of his call,  there is no smile on the veteran-looking staff at the egg station in the Regency Club Lounge,  and the staff was expressionless when Mr. Hayashi received the plate. Mr. Hayashi asked if this kind of attitude is following the hotel policy or not.
Although Mr. Hayashi mentioned that we have to improve the staff's attitude,  he was not asked to contact him back because he just wanted to tell us what he thought. ISC staff told him,  "Thank you for your valuable comment. I will report this to the management."
Mr. Hayashi told the same story to GR staff on the 9th floor. The way of his check-out is always EXP/OUT,  so we couldn't even talk to him when he checked out. Mr. Hayashi has a reservation for the next time on March 6th.  ISC Endo

The guest has a future reservation on May 15. As some time will have passed,  this matter will not be raised; however,  the relevant departments will be informed,  and we will ensure appropriate care.　April 13,  2026　Tobe

rows.Subject: 0736 | Ms. Samantha Chen | HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
2/20 外出時部屋のバスルームのカビが気になる。それが原因か分からないがお子様がアレルギーが出ているかもしれないと指摘あり。(メールもあり)ステイ清掃時に念入りに清掃を実施しお詫びレターとコーテシーを入室しました。ゲスト部屋に戻られ、再度お部屋にて気になるポイントの詳細を伺いお詫びし再度清掃を実施いたしました。　HK岩谷

<部屋タイプに関して>
元々RGSKで予約されていたが、ご主人様より全面的に改装された部屋の希望あり。希望に沿うならVDKまたはVDTだが、スイートアップグレードアワード(STEX)が無駄になってしまうのでご自身での変更をおすすめしましたが奥様もSTEXを取り除く必要はないとのこと。
翌日以降の部屋タイプ確保はできないと説明し、2/19に再度立ち寄りSTDKの空き状況を確認しにくるそうです。またRGSKも人気があるためRGSKに戻ることも確約できないと伝え済。2/18　丹羽
↓
再度立ち寄りあり、引き続き満室と回答済。 2/18 丹羽
↓
ご主人様が立ち寄りあり、本日は満室、STDKは2/20、SS3Dは2/21だけ現時点で空室があるが前日からの確約は不可と伝え済、了承。 2/19 丹羽
↓
再度ご主人様立ち寄りあり、満室と伝えたところ、「妻がこのまま移動できなければSTEXを無駄にしたと言っている。2/21が最終日であり、移動できなければあなたの名前を記載した上でBad Reviewを書く」と仰ったので、既に説明しているように前日からの確約はできかねており、非常に人気のある部屋タイプである＋IN時にSTEXは無駄になってしまう可能性があるためSTEXを外すことをおすすめしたと伝えるも、繰り返し「あなたの名前を記載してBad ReviewをSocial Media上に書く」と一方的に言われました。STEXに関しては「アワードは消費したかったからなくなることなんて気にしていない」と2/18に仰っていた。 2/20 丹羽

2/20,  While the guest was out,  they expressed concern about mold in the bathroom and mentioned that,  although they were unsure,  it might be causing their child’s allergic reaction. (we also received an email regarding this matter) During the stayover service,  we carried out a thorough cleaning and placed an apology letter along with a courtesy amenity in the room. After the guest returned to the room,  we visited again,  apologized,  carefully listened to the specific areas of concern,  and carried out an additional thorough cleaning.　　iwatani 

<Regarding Room Type>
The reservation was originally made under RGSK. However,  the husband requested a fully renovated room. Based on availability,  VDK or VDT would meet their preference. We advised that modifying the reservation would result in the Suite Upgrade Award (STEX) being forfeited and recommended that they make the change themselves if desired. The wife stated that they did not mind losing the STEX.
We explained that we could not guarantee availability of the desired room type for the following days. The guest mentioned they would return on 2/19 to check availability for STDK. We also informed them that RGSK is a popular room type and that returning to RGSK could not be guaranteed once changed. 2/18 Niwa
↓
Guest stopped by again and was informed that we remain fully booked. 2/18 Niwa
↓
The husband stopped by. Informed him that we are fully booked today. As of now,  STDK is available only on 2/20 and SS3D only on 2/21; however,  advance guarantee from the previous day is not possible. Guest acknowledged. 2/19 Niwa
↓
The husband stopped by again. Upon informing him that we are fully booked,  he stated,  “If my wife cannot move rooms,  she will say the STEX was wasted. 2/21 is our last day,  and if we cannot move,  she will write a bad review mentioning your name.”
We reiterated that,  as previously explained,  we cannot guarantee availability in advance due to popularity for these room types,  and at check-in we had advised removing the STEX because there was a possibility it would not be utilized. Despite this,  he repeatedly stated that he would write a bad review on social media including my name.
For reference,  on 2/18 the wife had clearly stated,  “We wanted to use the award,  so we do not mind if it is forfeited.” 2/20 Niwa

rows.Subject: 1121 | Mr. Antony Lurie | FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
上階煩いとISCに入電あり。昨日も煩かったようで、子供の足音が聞こえるみたいです。 2/20 戸村
↓
ﾍﾞﾙが確認したところ、12階は静か。ｹﾞｽﾄにC/Bしたところ、一緒に部屋で音を確認して欲しいとの事でﾍﾞﾙが伺う。
騒音は確認できたが、ﾍﾞﾙは横からの音だと思い、12階を再度確認後#1123に声掛けしようとしたら、既に不在。
再度C/Bし、状況説明し退室もあり、部屋はすでに静かになっているとの事でしたが、念のためｽﾘｰﾋﾟﾝｸﾞﾙｰﾑ提供をｵﾌｧｰするも「なせ自分が移動しなきゃいけないのか」と受け入れられず。ホテルとしては静かにお過ごしいただくように#1123にMSGをﾄﾞｱ下する旨、#1123は明日OUTのため明日以降は子供がいるｹﾞｽﾄをｱｻｲﾝしないようにするとお伝えし渋々ご理解いただきました。そもそもお子様がいるｹﾞｽﾄを隣にｱｻｲﾝしているこが理解できない・今後もし騒音があれば、怒るしｴｽｶﾚｰｼｮﾝしお金も払いたくないとの事。2/20　戸村

Received a call to ISC reporting noise from the room above. The guest mentioned that it was also noisy yesterday and that they could hear what sounded like children running.　2/20 Tomura
↓
Upon checking,  Bell staff confirmed that the 12th floor was quiet. After calling the guest back,  they requested that staff come to the room to confirm the noise together,  so Bell attended the room.
The noise was confirmed; however,  Bell believed it was coming from the side rather than directly above. After rechecking the 12th floor,  Bell attempted to contact Room #1123,  but the occupants were already out.
We called the guest back to explain the situation. The room had become quiet,  possibly due to the neighboring guests stepping out. As a precaution,  we offered a sleeping room; however,  the guest declined,  stating,  “Why should I have to move?”
We informed the guest that we would place a message under the door of Room #1123 requesting that they keep the noise down. Since Room #1123 is scheduled to check out tomorrow,  we also advised that we would avoid assigning guests with children to the nearby rooms from the following day onward. The guest reluctantly accepted this explanation.
They also expressed that they could not understand why guests with children had been assigned next to their room. They warned that if there is further noise,  they would become upset,  escalate the matter,  and would not want to pay.　2/20 Tomura

2/22 21:14 Consumer Affairs経由にて#717に滞在中のGLOBよりコンプレメールを受信。
（下記コンプレメールの概要）
2/22 12：30頃チェックインの為来館したが、部屋の清掃が終わっておらず、GSTへ丁重に14：00チェックインの旨案内を行い、その際にRCLの営業時間に関して問い合わせがあった模様。GSTの主張では、カクテルアワーは19：00-21：00と案内された為、外出先からﾎﾃﾙに戻る時間をスケジュールした上で戻りを19：00としていたとの事。フロントにてKEYとRCLの案内をされ、RCLを利用したところで、カクテルアワーが終了していたという事実が判明。RCLのスタッフへお腹が空いたからFoodはあるか尋ねたところ、Foodの提供は終わっており、ケーキ類の提供のみでありFoodの利用であればレストランを利用して欲しいと告げられたとの事。なお、スタッフの口調も優しい態度ではなかったとの事。
そもそも初めに来館した際にGLOBとしてのベネフィットの正しい情報が提供されていれば、その情報を元に予定を組むことが出来た。
↓
Consumer Affairsには滞在中のGSTの為、ホテル側でGSTへコンタクトを取り、状況の説明とお詫びなど対応をする旨返信済。
GSTに対しては、RCLの朝食利用時もしくは2/23日中部屋にMSGを点灯しピックアップがあれば、GSTからお話を伺い、お詫びをする予定。
事柄をフロント内、DM関係、Abdel課長、GRチームへ共有。2/23 5：00田中

Possible Misinformation Provided to Guest Regarding Cocktail Hour Hours at RCL
On 2/22 at 21:14,  a complaint email was received via Consumer Affairs from a GLOB guest staying in room #717.
(Summary of the complaint email below)
The guest arrived at the hotel around 12:30 on 2/22 to check in; however,  the room cleaning had not yet been completed. The guest was politely informed that check-in would be at 14:00. At that time,  the guest also inquired about the operating hours of the RCL. According to the guest,  they were informed that cocktail hour was from 19:00 to 21:00. Based on that information,  the guest scheduled their return to the hotel from an outing for 19:00.

At the front desk,  the guest received their key and information about the RCL. Upon visiting the RCL,  it was discovered that cocktail hour had already ended. The guest asked the RCL staff whether any food was available as they were hungry,  but was told that food service had already finished and that only cakes were available. They were advised to use the restaurant if they wished to have food. The guest also stated that the staff’s tone was not friendly.
The guest mentioned that if correct information regarding GLOB benefits had been provided at the time of the initial visit,  they would have been able to plan their schedule accordingly.
↓
We have already been informed Consumer Affairs that since the guest is still staying at the hotel,  the hotel will contact the guest directly to explain the situation and offer an apology.
We plan to speak with the guest and apologize either during their breakfast visit to the RCL or,  if a message light is activated in the guest room during the day on 2/23 and the guest contacts us,  at that time.
This matter has been shared with the Front Desk team,  Duty Managers,  Abdel FOM,  and the GR team. 2/23 5:00 Tanaka

rows.Incident Item Name: FO Other Issue フロントその他

チェックイン時の対応とスイートルームにアップグレードできないことに対してクレーム

Complaint regarding the check-in process and the inability to upgrade to a suite room
rows.Subject: Others その他 | Chunxue Shao Dr. John Yojun Zing | FO Other Issue フロントその他　2/25Arrival->Cancelled
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
2/25 14:40頃到着。 
WOHのプライオリティーレーンに並んでいて、少し離れたところにいたスタッフが空いたのでそちらに案内したことに対して一つ目のクレームをいただいた。
実際にC/INに来たのはDr. John Yojun Zingだが、予約はHan Ching Capitalという会社の別人の名前でShao,  Chunxueの名前で作成されており、予約を見つけるのに時間がかかったことに対して2つ目のクレームをいただいた。
また、対応したスタッフの英語がゲストにとって分かりにくかったようで、それについて3つ目のクレームをいただいた。
予約はゲストルームキングで作成されており、ゲストは「自分はコーテシーカードホルダーだからスイートルームへアップグレードしろ」と主張したがあいにくすべてのスイートが満室のためアップグレードはできないことを案内したところ、GMを出せ、と怒り始めた。
佐藤が代わって説明したがご理解いただけず、もっと上の者を出せ、GMと話をさせろと30分ほど主張を繰り返した。
GMもEAMも宿泊部長も離席中のためすぐには対応できない、戻り次第連絡させることを提案したところ、2時間以内に連絡がない場合はDavid Udellに直接連絡すると言い残して立ち去った。予約はキャンセルされる予定。

なお、Dr. John Yojun ZingはWOHの会員番号を持っていたが(551419694B)、無効カードになっており、GEM Notes上には支払い不良を理由に今後の利用を断る旨のPHTの記述と、HR京都でも支払い不良が発生した記録があった。　無効カードになった経緯についてGCCに問い合わせてみたが、原因は不明で、無効カードなのでこれ以上の対応は不要だろうとのことであった。佐藤



Arrived around 2:40 PM on 2/25.
We received the first complaint regarding being directed to a different staff member who became available while we were waiting in the WOH priority lane.
The guest who actually arrived for check-in was Dr. John Yojun Zing,  but the reservation was made under the name Shao,  Chunxue for someone else from a company called Han Ching Capital. The second complaint was about the time it took to locate the reservation.
Additionally,  the guest found the English of the staff member assisting them difficult to understand,  leading to a third complaint.
The reservation was booked for a Guest Room King,  but the guest insisted,  “I'm a Courtesy Card holder,  so upgrade me to a suite.” Unfortunately,  all suites were fully booked,  so we explained an upgrade wasn't possible. He then became angry,  demanding to see the GM.
Sato took over the explanation,  but the guest remained unconvinced. He insisted for about 30 minutes,  demanding to see someone higher up and to speak directly with the GM.
Since the GM,  EAM,  and Lodging Manager were all away from their desks,  we couldn't assist immediately. We proposed contacting them as soon as they returned. He left,  stating he would contact David Udell directly if there was no contact within two hours. The reservation is scheduled to be canceled.

Note: Dr. John Yojun Zing held a WOH membership number (551419694B),  but it was an invalid card.  GEM Notes contained a PHT entry stating future use was denied due to payment delinquency,  and HR Kyoto also had records of payment issues occurring. We inquired with GCC about the circumstances leading to the card's invalidation,  but the cause remains unknown. Since the card is invalid,  no further action is deemed necessary. Sato
rows.Feedback Remarks 1: 終了
rows.item_norm: FO Other Issue フロントその他

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
17:00過ぎにGSTが到着した際、前泊者がレイトアウトされていたため、清掃が終了していなかった。HKに仕上がり時間を確認したところ17:30頃と判明。丁重にお詫びしRCL待ちを提案し了承いただいた。その際はお怒りの様子ではなかったが、GR齋藤さんよりRCLにて声を荒げてお怒りであると連絡が入る。待機部屋を用意している間に#617がVRになったためKEYを作成しRCLへお持ちした。その後、部屋まで案内した際は終始落ち着いた様子だった。来館時に待機部屋の提案もすべきだったがRCLのみの提案となってしまった。2/28にコーテシーを入室し、OUT時お声がけ予定。2/27 丹羽

When the guest arrived after 5:00 PM,  the room had not yet been cleaned because the previous guest had a late check-out. Upon confirming with Housekeeping,  we were informed that the room would be ready at approximately 5:30 PM. We sincerely apologized and offered waiting in the RCL,  which he accepted. At that time,  the guest did not appear upset; however,  we later received a call from Mr. Saito (GR) informing us that the guest had raised their voice and was upset in the RCL.
While preparing a temporary waiting room,  Room #617 became ready (VR),  so we immediately prepared the key and delivered it to the RCL. When escorting the guest to the room afterward,  he appeared calm throughout.
Although we should have offered a waiting room upon the guest’s arrival,  we only suggested waiting in the RCL. An amenity will be delivered on February 28,  and we plan to follow up with the guest again at check-out. 2/27 Niwa

OUT時、精算のためクレジットカードを再度提示していただけるよう依頼したところ、到着時に部屋の鍵を返却するだけでOUTできると聞いたと仰りご立腹。お詫びし、クレジットカードを頂戴した。
部屋の騒音に関してお詫びしようとしたところで、GSTから2/27-2泊分の部屋代が明細から引かれているか聞かれた。そのような記録はなかったため、部屋代を全て引くことは出来兼ねるが、お詫びとして2泊分のサービス料免除を提案。
しかし騒音クレームを対応した際に、MGRが2泊分の部屋代を免除すると約束したと主張。そのような記録もなく、実際に対応した佐藤マネジャーに伺ったがそんな話はしていなかった。
GSTに2日分の部屋代を全て引くことはできない旨を再度説明したところ、「全て支払っても今晩AMEXに連絡し支払いを取り消してもらう。2泊以外の部屋代を私たちが支払うか、全額徴収できないかどちらか選んで」と仰いましたがお断りし全額払っていただいた。

話の中で、引継ぎ内容の画面を撮影させろ、ソーシャルメディアにこのことを書くなどの発言もあった。 3/4 丹羽

At check-out, when I requested the guest to present the credit card again for settlement, she became upset, stating that she had been told at arrival that he could check out simply by returning the room key. I apologized for the misunderstanding and proceeded to obtain the credit card for payment.

When I attempted to apologize for the noise disturbance in the room, the guest asked whether the room charges for the two nights (2/27–2/28) had already been removed from the bill. As there was no such record, I explained that we were unable to waive the full room charges; however, as a gesture of apology, I offered to waive the service charge for the two nights.

The guest then claimed that when the noise complaint was handled, the manager had promised to waive the room charges for the two nights. There was no record of such a promise, and after confirming with Manager Sato, who had handled the case, he stated that no such agreement had been made.

I again explained to the guest that we could not waive the full room charges for the two nights. The guest responded that even if she paid in full, she would contact AMEX that evening to dispute the charge, and told us to choose either to waive the two nights’ room charges or risk not being able to collect the full amount. We declined this request and ultimately collected the full payment.

During the conversation, the guest also demanded to take a photo of the handover on opera on the screen and stated that they would post about this matter on social media. 3/4 Niwa

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
お婆様の容体悪化に伴う救急車手配あり。
23：30頃ISC経由でﾌﾛﾝﾄに入電。PTY#2625に登録のあるMs. Lo,  Kam Shuenの体調が悪いとのことで救急車要請あり。3/4にﾁｪｯｸｲﾝするまでは元気であったが、18時頃にゆでｶﾞﾆを少し食べてから容体が悪化し、9回ほど嘔吐が続き激しい腹痛があり救急車を要請したとのこと。家族は特に体調に問題はなく、お婆様のみの容体変化でした。救急隊が到着後、血圧等に異常は見られなかったものの病院の受診を勧められ、ご家族はお金がかかっても受診を希望されましたが、ご本人が受診を拒否した為、その場での搬送はCXLになりました。ご家族曰く救急隊の到着から少し容体も落ち着いたとのことでした。本人が病院の受診を拒んでいたので、3/5以降に病院を受信したいならいつでも声をかけていただくようにお伝えして、退室しています。　3/4　水谷

Ambulance Arranged Due to Grandmother’s Worsening Condition
At around 23:30,  I received a call via ISC. There was a request to call an ambulance for Ms. Lo,  Kam Shuen,  who is registered under PTY #2625,  due to a sudden deterioration in her condition.
She had been in good health until checking in on March 4. However,  after eating a small amount of boiled crab around 18:00,  her condition worsened. She reportedly vomited approximately nine times and experienced severe abdominal pain,  prompting the family to request an ambulance. No other family members experienced any health issues; only the grandmother’s condition changed.
After the emergency team arrived,  no abnormalities were found in her blood pressure or other vital signs. Although the paramedics recommended that she visit a hospital for further examination,  and the family expressed their willingness to proceed even if there were costs involved,  the patient herself refused to go. Therefore,  the transport was canceled on site.
According to the family,  her condition had somewhat stabilized by the time the ambulance arrived. As she declined to visit the hospital,  we informed the family that they could contact us at any time should they wish to arrange a hospital visit on or after March 5. After this,  we left the room. 3/4 Mizutani

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
チェックイン時に担当者が本GSTより業務上のハラスメントを言葉と態度で受けた。オペレーション通りパスポートもしくはIDの提示を求めたが強く拒否された。GSTの主張では日本に在住しているので法律上パスポートの提示義務はないと強調された。一年前に宿泊した際には同様の事案があったとのこと。セキュリティの為である旨丁重に説明したが、GSTの振る舞いや態度はさらにエスカレートし、Hyatt Hotelとしてのレベルの低さを言い、また自身のバックグランドについて自慢をしだした。GSTが所有するプロファイルにはID提示不要とあったが、今回OTA予約の為反映されておらず、ID提示依頼については正しいチェックインプロセスであった。戸部部長が対応したがそこでもGSTはチェックインクラークのことを「罵る言葉」や「黙れ！」と言うような許されない言葉を浴びせられた。

At the time of check-in,  chack in clerk was subjected to work-related harassment from the guest through both words and behavior. The staff requested the guest to present a passport or ID in accordance with the standard operational procedure; however,  the guest strongly refused. The guest insisted that,  because he resides in Japan,  he is not legally required to present a passport. The guest also claimed that a similar situation had occurred during a previous stay about one year ago.
The staff politely explained that the request was for security purposes; however,  the guest’s behavior and attitude further escalated. The guest criticized the low standards of the Hyatt hotel and began boasting about his own background. Although the guest’s profile indicated that ID presentation was not required,  this information was not reflected in the reservation because the booking had been made through an OTA. Therefore,  the request for ID was in accordance with the correct check-in procedure.
Tobe DOR later intervened to handle the situation; however,  even at that time the guest directed unacceptable language toward the check-in clerk,  including insults and statements such as "stupid",  “Shut up.”


元々2014年の宿泊時に日本在住にもかかわらずパスポートの提示を求められたことに対してクレームが発生していたゲスト。
今回はOTA経由で予約が入っていたため、ゲストのプロファイルがついておらず、通常のゲストとして扱われ、パスポートの提示、日本在住なら在留カードを提示してほしいと依頼したところ前にも見せたのにと立腹しました。UPグレードしてお詫びしました。　日本に住所を持つ外国人（在留外国人）がホテルに宿泊する際、在留カードの提示は法律で義務付けられていませんので、このゲストについては今後提示不要のNotesをいれました。3/6/2026　戸部

A guest who had previously filed a complaint in 2014 about being asked to present their passport despite residing in Japan during their stay.
This time,  the reservation was made through an OTA,  so the guest had no profile and was treated as a regular guest. When asked to present their passport or,  if residing in Japan,  their residence card,  they became angry,  stating they had already shown it before. We upgraded them as an apology.　Foreign residents with a Japanese address are not legally required to present their residence card when staying at a hotel. Therefore,  we added a note stating this guest is exempt from future presentation requirements. 3/6/2026 Tobe

rows.Subject: 1410 | Mr. Howard Cohn | FO Other Issue フロントその他　　3/22OUT
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
＜朝食料金に関するｸﾚｰﾑおよび不適切発言について＞
3月15日、ﾌﾛﾝﾄに立寄り、朝食料金についてｸﾚｰﾑ。
公式ｻｲﾄ上では、朝食付き1名利用と2名利用の料金差額が JPY 1, 800 のみである一方、ﾁｪｯｸｲﾝ時には朝食料金が JPY 5, 000 と案内されたため、不公平であるとのご指摘があり、公式ｻｲﾄ上と同様の料金、もしくは同等の割引の適用を希望されました。DMより、朝食料金は予約時にパッケージとして事前購入されているかどうかにより異なること、また到着後に適用可能な割引は最大 15％ までである旨をご説明。
その後、「割引が適用できないのであれば予約をｷｬﾝｾﾙしたい」と申し出がありましたが、 MYHIAB でのご予約のため返金不可であり、ｷｬﾝｾﾙによる返金対応はできない旨をDMより説明。
説明の過程で、ﾋｰﾄｱｯﾌﾟし、Abdel課長より直接対応し、事前購入条件および適用可能な朝食料金について改めてご説明し、複数回にわたりお詫びもお伝えしましたが、ゲストは引き続き攻撃的な態度を取り、さらに「今すぐHyattのCOOに携帯電話で電話しろ」と要求されました。 また、以下のような不適切な発言もありました。「銃を突きつけて脅しているのか？」「このﾎﾃﾙはﾔｸｻﾞのﾎﾃﾙなのか？」他のお客様がﾁｪｯｸｲﾝ中であるにもかかわらず、ﾌﾛﾝﾄにて大声を出し続け、ﾛﾋﾞｰに混乱を生じさせ、当初はその場を離れることも拒否されました。 この段階で、Abdelさん より、当該行為は容認できない旨を毅然とお伝えし、このような態度を続ける場合には当ﾎﾃﾙでのご滞在をお断りせざるを得ない可能性があることを明確にお伝えしました。その後、この対応と明確な警告により、ゲストは落ち着きを取り戻し、最終的には 朝食15％割引 にてご利用されることで了承されました。朝食代金はチェックアウト時精算予定。3/15　石田


The guest approached the FD on 15 March to raise a complaint regarding the breakfast pricing. The guest stated that,  on the official website,  the difference between a room booked with breakfast for one person versus two persons was only JPY 2, 800,  whereas at check-in they were informed that breakfast would be charged at JPY 5, 000. The guest requested that the same online pricing or discount be applied.
DM explained that breakfast pricing differs depending on whether it is reserved in advance as part of the booking package. It was also explained that,  after arrival,  the maximum discount we are able to offer is 15%,  .The guest then stated that if the discount could not be applied,  they wished to cancel the reservation. DM further explained that,  as the reservation was booked under MYHIAB,  it is non-refundable and therefore cancellation with refund was not possible. During this explanation,  the guest became increasingly aggressive. Abdel-san personally aproached the guest and explained the advance purchase condition and the applicable breakfast pricing. Despite this explanation with Multiple apologies were extended,  the guest continued to behave aggressively and demanded that we call Hyatt’s COO on his mobile phone immediately. The guest also used inappropriate language,  including remarks such as:“Are you threatening me with a gun?” “Is this hotel run by the yakuza?”  The guest continued raising his voice at the Front Desk while other guests were checkin in,  causing a disturbance in the lobby area,  and initially refused to leave the desk.
At this stage,  Abdel-san firmly informed the guest that this behavior is unacceptable and that if he continued to act in this manner,  he would not be welcome to stay at the hotel. Following this intervention and clear warning,  the guest calmed down and ultimately agreed to proceed with breakfast at the 15% discounted rate. 
Payment for breakfast is to be settled at check-out.3/15　Ishida
