rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
STEX Awardに関して
GSTが持っている予約確認には確かに2室ともSTEX Awardが明記されていたが、OPERA上では1室のみ反映されていた。MGR Callとなり田中対応。GCCへその場で問い合わせ。Ms. Takeに調べて貰ったところ、GCCアメリカにてSTEXが取り消されていることが判明したが、GCCアメリカがGSTに対してどういった案内・説明をしたかメールで負えないとの事。ただ、GSTはSTEXが適用されていると思って来館されているので、GCC側で調査してアメリカチームからGSTに追って説明をさせるとの事。 DM田中の判断でGSTに丁重にお詫びと説明をして、STEXが貼りついていない状態で#1123(SS3D)の部屋の特徴を写真を見せながら案内をしてお待たせしてしまったことも鑑みてホテルからの気持ちとしてSS3Dを提供しています。GSTも喜んでいただき、チェックイン後特に追加で問い合わせは無。GST自身でもGCCアメリカに連絡してみるとの事。 ホテルからGSTに対してコンペンセーションの予定は無。Good Careとして共有します。滞在中にAwardが張り付くことも考えられる為、プロファイルは変更しておりません。3/15 田中

Regarding the STEX Award
The guest’s confirmation clearly indicated that the STEX Award was applied to both rooms; however,  in OPERA it was reflected in only one room. This became a manager call,  and Tanaka handled the case. We contacted GCC at the same time.
After Ms. Take from GCC investigated,  it was discovered that the STEX had been cancelled by GCC America. However,  GCC stated that they were unable to track by email what kind of guidance or explanation had been provided to the guest by the U.S. team. Since the guest arrived believing that the STEX was applied,  GCC will investigate further and have the U.S. team follow up directly with the guest with an explanation.
Based on DM Tanaka’s decision,  we sincerely apologized and explained the situation to the guest. As the STEX was not attached,  we introduced the features of room #1123 (SS3D) while showing photos,  and considering the waiting time,  the hotel offered SS3D as a gesture of goodwill. The guest was pleased and did not make any additional inquiries after check-in. The guest also mentioned that they would try contacting GCC America themselves.
There are no plans for compensation from the hotel to the guest. This is being shared as Good Care. Since it is possible that the Award may be attached during the stay,  the profile has not been changed.3/15 Tanaka

3/15、19：00、4名、TEPPANYAKI 10 渋谷スクランブルスクエア店 コンシェルジュ経由で予約済。
時間前に店に着いたが時間が過ぎても待たされた。鉄板焼きレストランなのに初めにテーブル席を案内されたことに対して怒られる。
海外から来てライブ感を味わえるカウンター席を楽しみにしていた。予約をお願いした際にコンシェルジュから席の要望に関して質問が無く、実際に店舗についたらカウンターではなかったのでがっかり。席に関してはGSTが店で無理を言って結果的にカウンターに座れた模様。
GSTよりお店の電話からコンシェルジュ宛に苦言の電話あり。帰館時にDMと話させろと言って電話は終わったとのこと。
↓
22：00頃GSTが戻られ、DMとして田中が45分ほど対応。上記の通りコンシェルジュに関することのほか下記に関しても苦言をいただく。
部屋までのアテンドをして欲しかった。RCL内のスタッフの振る舞いが機械的に笑顔が無い。RCL入口のスタッフがPCばかり見ていた。レストランスタッフも慌ただしい。
笑顔が無いことに関してはチームの課題として共有しているが、今回いただいたフィードバックは是非改めてチームに共有をして今後の為に活かさせていただきたい。レストラン予約に関しては翌朝コンシェルジュマネジャーとも再度協議をして改めてお話をさせてくださいと言って終話。
GSTは午前9時ころRCL利用。その後観光のために外出予定とのこと。3/16田中
↓
Out時、再度謝罪済み。飛行機の遅延とタクシー送迎の時間にずれが生じ、一度外出後、14:00に帰館するので、14:00～15:00の間、RCLを使用したいとの申し出があり、了承しております。
外出される際は終始笑顔で、DM田中さんには「お疲れの中、話をしっかり聞いてくれてありがとう」と伝えてほしいと仰っていました。
RCL利用に関して、カシャさん・GR・丹羽DMには既に伝えております。 3/17 岩田
↓
15:00頃、帰館。時間がなくRCLは利用せず、お預かりをしていたお荷物をタクシー乗り場までお手伝いし、お見送り済み。 3/17 岩田

On 3/15 at 19:00,  a reservation for 4 people was made at Teppanyaki 10 Shibuya Scramble Square through the concierge.
The guests arrived at the restaurant before the reservation time but were kept waiting even after the scheduled time. They became upset that,  despite it being a teppanyaki restaurant,  they were initially guided to a table seat instead of a counter seat. As they had come from overseas,  they were looking forward to experiencing the live cooking atmosphere at the counter. When they requested the reservation,  the concierge did not ask about seating preferences,  and they were disappointed when they arrived and found they were not seated at the counter. In the end,  the guest insisted at the restaurant and was able to move to the counter seat. The guest called the concierge from the restaurant’s phone to express their dissatisfaction. It was reported that the call ended with the guest saying they wanted to speak with the Duty Manager upon returning to the hotel.
↓
Around 22:00,  the guest returned to the hotel,  and Tanaka handled the matter as the Duty Manager for about 45 minutes. In addition to the concerns regarding the concierge mentioned above,  the guest also raised the following points:
They wanted to be escorted to their room.
Staff behavior in the RCL felt mechanical and lacked smiles.
The staff at the RCL entrance were focused only on their computers.
Restaurant staff appeared rushed.
Regarding the lack of smiles,  this has already been recognized as a team issue,  but the feedback received on this occasion will be shared with the team again and used for improvement going forward. Regarding the restaurant reservation,  the conversation concluded with informing the guest that we would discuss the matter again with the Concierge Manager the following morning and provide a follow-up explanation.
The guest planned to use the RCL around 9:00 the next morning and then go out for sightseeing.3/16 Tanaka
↓
At the time of check out,  we apologized guest again. Due to a delay in their flight and a mismatch with the taxi schedule,  they went out once and planned to return to the hotel at 14:00. They requested to use the RCL between 14:00 and 15:00,  which we approved.
During their outing,  they maintained a smile throughout and asked that DM Tanaka be told,  “Thank you for listening carefully despite being tired.”
Regarding the use of the RCL,  this has already been communicated to Kasha-san,  GR,  and DM Niwa. 3/17 Iwata
↓
Around 15:00,  the guest returned to the hotel. Due to limited time,  they did not use the RCL. We assisted with the luggage that had been kept and saw the guest off to the taxi stand. 3/17 Iwata

rows.Incident Description:
フロントデスクのカード決済端末で通信エラーが起き、決済やカードチェックが出来ない状況に陥った。 3/18 丹羽

We experienced a network error with our front desk credit card payment terminal, we were temporarily unable to process payments or check its validity. 3/18 Niwa
rows.Subject: ロビー | N/A N/A | FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
3/18 14:45頃 クレジットカードの有効確認を試みるも読込中で画面が進まず、1分程してネットワークエラーと表示された。フロント1-8号機、GRカウンター、フロント裏にある端末全てで同様のエラーを確認したため、情報システム課に報告した。

その後、情報システム課にて端末を確認。端末に記載の問い合わせ番号に連絡するもしばらく繋がらず。その間、1980及びクロスロードキッチンでも同様のエラーが発生していることを確認。その後全国的に発生している事象と判明。

18:00頃 復旧。復旧までの間、フロントでチェックインされたゲストの内、支払いがあるゲストに対してはクレジットカードのドラフトを取得した。ご立腹のゲスト特になし。 3/18　丹羽

At approximately 14:45 on March 18,  we attempted to perform a credit card authorization; however,  the screen remained on the loading page and did not proceed. After about one minute,  a network error message was displayed.

The same error was confirmed on all front desk terminals (Units 1–8),  the GR counter,  and the back office terminal. The issue was then reported to the IT Department.

Subsequently,  the IT Department checked the terminals and attempted to contact the support number listed on the device; however,  they were unable to connect for some time. Meanwhile,  it was confirmed that the same issue was also occurring at 1980 and Crossroads Kitchen. It was later determined that this was a nationwide system issue.

At approximately 18:00,  the system was restored. During the outage,  for guests checking in at the front desk who required payment,  we obtained credit card imprints (drafts) as an alternative. No significant guest complaints were reported. 3/18 Niwa

Cases of customer harassment upon arrival at the hotel and during the stay—March 19, Tanaka
rows.Subject: 1223 | Yoshitaka Oikawa | FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
カスタマーハラスメント案件
3/18 18：00頃 チェックイン
ホテル到着時のレセプションまでのアテンドしたスタッフへの高圧的な態度。部屋へのアテンドは問題なし。

3/19 7:15頃 RCLにおいてラウンジスタッフに対して高圧的な態度・言動を取るため対応するスタッフは委縮してしまう
入口のスタッフ、RCLスタッフのホテルマンとしてなっていないと苦言

3/19 7:30 ロビーに降りてきた際頼んでいた荷物の準備がされていないとクレーム（タグを渡してくれない上に元々ロビースタッフに伝えていたタクシー乗車時間になっても現れなかったため）

3/19 7:45 外線にてDM Call　田中対応
タクシーにスムーズに乗車できなかった。東京駅に着くのが遅れそうだ。新幹線代を払え。とのことだがお断り。東京駅につくから電話を切ってくれとのことで切電

3/19 8：10 再度外線 DMからCall Back　石田対応
上記に加え、タクシー代を払えとの事。ホテルが支払うことはしないのでお断り。GSTには部屋付けをするから支払ってくださいと何度も伝えて了承を得ています。

3/19 8：30頃
タクシー運転手がホテルに帰館。東京駅に着いて本人はタクシー代を払わずにホテルに払わせろと運転手に命令したとのこと。利用明細をロビースタッフに手渡し。運転手には立て替え済。タクシー代￥4380-部屋付け済。

上記の内容を踏まえ、戸部より顧問弁護士にカスタマーハラスメント案件として、即時退去や出入り禁止対応がとれるか確認したところ、一旦は厳重注意とし、同じ事柄があった場合は即時退去・出入り禁止対応の流れにしたほうがよいとの助言があり、帰還時に伝えることとした。

3/20 0：30頃
荷物の受け取りのため、ISCに連絡あり。西郷DMが荷物とともに部屋に伺い、本日起こった事柄を伝え、厳重注意を行い、今後このような事柄があった場合には即時退去と出入り禁止にさせていただく旨通達した。ゲストは終始落ち着いた感じで聞いており、事柄を了承した。 


Customer Harassment Case

March 18,  around 18:00 – Check-in
Upon arrival at the hotel,  the guest displayed an intimidating and high-pressure attitude toward the staff member who escorted them to the reception. No issues were observed during the room escort.

March 19,  around 7:15 – At RCL
The guest exhibited intimidating behavior and language toward lounge staff,  causing staff members to feel intimidated.
The guest also complained that both the entrance staff and RCL staff were not acting professionally as hotel personnel.

March 19,  7:30
When the guest came down to the lobby,  they complained that their requested luggage had not been prepared. (The guest had not provided a baggage tag,  and despite having previously informed lobby staff of their taxi boarding time,  they did not appear at the scheduled time.)

March 19,  7:45 – External Call (Handled by Tanaka)
The guest stated that they were unable to board the taxi smoothly and might be late arriving at Tokyo Station. They demanded that the hotel pay for the Shinkansen ticket,  which was declined.
The guest then stated they were arriving at Tokyo Station and requested the call be ended.

March 19,  8:10 – Call Back from Guest (Handled by Ishida)
In addition to the above,  the guest demanded that the hotel pay for the taxi fare. This was declined.
The guest was repeatedly informed that the taxi fare would be charged to their room,  and they acknowledged this.

March 19,  around 8:30
The taxi driver returned to the hotel. The driver reported that upon arrival at Tokyo Station,  the guest refused to pay the fare and instructed the driver to collect payment from the hotel.
The driver handed over the receipt to the lobby staff. The hotel paid the fare on behalf of the guest.
Taxi fare: ¥4, 380 – Charged to the guest room.

Based on the above,  Tobe consulted with the legal advisor regarding whether immediate eviction or a ban could be enforced as a customer harassment case.
The advice received was to issue a strict warning for now,  and in the event of a repeated offense,  proceed with immediate eviction and a ban from the premises.It was decided to communicate this to the guest upon their return.

March 20,  around 0:30
The guest contacted ISC to receive their luggage. DM Saigo visited the guest room with the luggage,  explained the incidents that occurred,  issued a strict warning,  and informed the guest that any further such behavior would result in immediate eviction and a ban from the hotel.
The guest remained calm throughout,  listened to the explanation,  and acknowledged the matter.
rows.Feedback Remarks 1: 13:45ﾀｸｼｰにて出発。諸々OPERAに残してます。

rows.Subject: 1909 | Ms. Chenju Lin | HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備　　3/23OUT
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
3/19 22:00
FCS経由で虫に刺されたからとシーツ交換の依頼が入る。HKスタッフが訪問すると責任者と話がしたいとのことでMGRコールになった。
西郷が訪問し話を伺った。既にシーツ交換作業中だった。
昨日、左足脛に虫に刺されたと跡を見せられた。
ベッドバグを調査する場合、シーツなどは交換せずそのままにしなければならない、とお伝えし理解された。
R/Cをオファーしたが荷物が多いからと一旦は固辞された。
荷物の移動は明日でも構わないのでスリーピングルームの用意が出来る旨をお伝えしたところ、主人が戻ってから相談すると言って終話。
その後、ご主人が帰館されスリーピングルームを利用したいとDM宛に連絡。
#1909の鍵をお渡しした。3/20に#1609→#1909にR/Cを実行する予定。3/19 西郷
↓
殺虫業者手配し＃1909へは業者が確認する旨、レター入室しています。　3/20　HK iwatani
↓
3/22 16:00
害虫駆除業者が来館し検査および駆除作業を行いました。検査の結果、トコジラミの痕跡や証拠は確認されませんでした。
正式な報告書については、今晩から明日の午前8時までの間に当ホテルへ提出するよう依頼済。　HK中野　


3/19 22:00
A request for a sheet change was received via FCS,  with the guest claiming an insect bite. When HK staff visited the room,  the guest requested to speak with a manager,  resulting in an MGR call.
Saigo attended and spoke with the guest. The sheet change was already in progress at that time.
The guest showed a mark on the left shin,  claiming it was caused by an insect bite the previous day.
The guest was informed that,  in the case of a bed bug investigation,  items such as sheets should not be changed and must be left as is. The guest acknowledged and understood.
A room change (R/C) was offered but was initially declined due to the amount of luggage.
The guest was informed that luggage transfer could be arranged the following day and that a sleeping room could be prepared. The guest stated they would discuss it with their husband upon his return,  and the conversation concluded.
Later,  after the husband returned,  the guest contacted DM requesting to use a sleeping room.
A key for Room #1909 was provided. A room change from #1609 to #1909 is scheduled for March 20.    3/19 Saigo
↓
We have arranged for a pest control service,  and a letter has been placed in Room #1909 informing that the vendor will be conducting an inspection.  3/20 HK iwatani
↓
March 22,  16:00
A pest control company visited the hotel to conduct an inspection and extermination. The inspection confirmed that no signs or evidence of bed bugs were found.
We have requested that the official report be submitted to the hotel between this evening and 8:00 a.m. tomorrow.　-HK Nakano
rows.Feedback Remarks 1:
OUT済
検査結果を説明し、補償の対象にはならないことを説明したが納得していない様子であった

rows.Incident Description:
他室からの騒音に関する苦情について 3/22 岩田

Complaint Regarding Noise from Another Unit 3/22 Iwata
rows.Subject: 2005 | Mr. Milan Blbas | FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情　　2/27OUT
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
<騒音によるクレーム>
3月22日1:30頃、近隣客室の騒音によりご本人およびお子様が就寝できないとの連絡がISC経由でDMに入る。現地へ向かうと、Mr. Blbasが#2005前におり、#2014からの出入りや大声について申告あり。実際に廊下まで声が聞こえる状況を確認。
直ちに#2014の客室を訪問し、ゲストへ厳重注意を実施。その後、Mr. Blbasへ対応内容を説明し謝罪。再度騒音があった場合、ご自身で注意すると発言されたため、その行為は控えていただくようお願いし、今後はDMへ連絡いただければ対応する旨を案内。当初はご立腹の様子であったが、注意の様子をご確認いただき、ご納得いただけた。Out時再度、お声掛け予定。 3/22 岩田

At approximately 1:30 AM on March 22,  a direct message was received via ISC reporting that the guest and their child were unable to sleep due to noise from a nearby room. Upon proceeding to the location,  Mr. Blbas was found standing in front of Room #2005 and reported loud voices and frequent traffic in and out of Room #2014. The noise level was confirmed,  as voices could be clearly heard from the hallway.

I immediately visited Room #2014 and issued a strict warning to the occupants. Following this,  an explanation of the actions taken was provided to Mr. Blbas along with an apology. As Mr. Blbas indicated that he would personally address the situation if the noise continued,  he was politely requested to refrain from doing so and to contact us via direct message instead,  so that Duty Manager could handle the matter.

③C/INに時間がかかった→9:30頃到着され、RCLに確認して案内したなどあったが、特に目立った遅延はなし。
④3/22になだ万を利用し、グルテンフリーに問題がないと確認して予約したが店舗スタッフと英語でコミュニケーションが取れなかった。国際的なホテルではありえない
⑤2025年7月に予約したのに、UPされた部屋が小さすぎる⇒UPは当日の空き状況によると回答済。 
⑥BFはLGだとレストランとRCLで選択できるはず→RCLがあるホテルではラウンジのみと回答済。3/23 丹羽

A complaint was received regarding the following issues during the guest’s stay:
Delayed Email Communication Prior to Arrival
The guest claimed that email communication from the time of booking until arrival was slow. Upon review,  the correspondence was primarily handled through GCC. There was no communication via GR,  and only one message was sent by the Concierge team.
Amenities Missing in Room #727 (HONR)
The guest noted that,  although staying under HONR status,  courtesy items and pillow mist were not provided and should have been included.
→ Standard procedure does not include these items for HONR rooms; however,  they were exceptionally placed in the room on this occasion.
Delay at Check-in
The guest reported a long check-in time. They arrived around 9:30 AM,  and guidance was provided after confirming with RCL. No significant delay was observed.
Restaurant Experience (Nadaman on March 22)
The guest dined at Nadaman after confirming gluten-free options at the time of booking. However,  they experienced difficulty communicating in English with restaurant staff and expressed dissatisfaction,  stating this is unacceptable for an international hotel.
Room Upgrade Concern
The guest stated that despite booking in July 2025,  the upgraded room was too small.
→ It has already been explained that upgrades are subject to availability on the day of arrival.
Breakfast Benefit (LG)
The guest expected to choose between the restaurant and RCL for breakfast.
→ It has been explained that at properties with an RCL,  breakfast is provided in the lounge only.　3/23　Niwa

rows.Incident Item Name: FO Room Complaint 部屋に関する苦情
rows.Incident Description:
Mr. Fredman made a reservation starting from the 25th march in order to secure early arrival on the 26th of march. Due to human error, the reservation was mistakenly canceled in the system prior to arrival. As a result, the suite category originally booked was fully occupied on the day of arrival.
Mr. Fredman arrived at the hotel at approximately 11:00 AM. Duty Manager met the guest upon arrival, extended a sincere apology, and offered a temporary room for rest while the issue was being resolved. The guest, however, was frustrated and declined to move from the front desk.
FOM Approached the guest apologized and acknowledged the mistake. During the conversation, Mr. Fredman indicated that he only needed to store his luggage and would be leaving the hotel for the day.  courtesy room was offered for his convenience.
At approximately 3:00 PM, upon the guest’s return, the team managed to reassign rooms by coordinating with other arrivals. Mr. Fredman was then provided with the same suite category he had originally reserved and as Resolution we Offered to waive the charge for the night of the 25th unused night and the suite upgrade award.
The guest was not satisfied with the proposed resolution and requested the following compensation:
Two complimentary nights
Removal of the suite upgrade award
Removal of the honor award for his Future reservation
Transfer of billing for the second reservation from Ms. Dotan’s account to Mr. Fredman’s account for point eligibility
Complimentary dinner for four adults
All requests were reviewed and politely declined. We reiterated the offer to waive the unused night as a fair resolution.
Mr. Fredman requested to escalate  further. The Consumer Affairs contact email was provided to him for formal follow-up.

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:

3/30朝RCLにて申告あり。RCLにてｼｮｳｶﾞ湯が欲しい、とのRQがあり用意が無いためお断りしたところ3/29夜の食事を食べたら体調を崩したと申告あり発覚。3/30朝は普通に食事をとっていたとのこと。3/29夜に提供した検体を確認しMSG予定。
以下備考
男性：ｸﾗｹﾞ、ｷｭｳﾘ、ｽﾓｰｸｻｰﾓﾝを喫食　女性：牛肉を喫食と申告あり。
男性は下痢、女性は嘔吐　3/30　石田

<調理部からの状況確認>
【 当日の提供状況】
・カクテルタイム入客数：78名
・中華前菜2種：各30個、35個
・スモークサーモン：2台
・サーモンソテー：1.5台
・きゅうり：1台
・肉料理：4台
【 現時点の確認事項】
・当日提供料理の検体保管を確認済みです。
・加熱食材については温度記録を確認済みです。
・当該料理の提供担当スタッフ、および当日出勤スタッフについて、現時点で体調不良者がいないことを確認しております。
・現時点において、他のゲストから同様の体調不良申告は受けておりません。

3/30午後、戸部よりゲストに連絡するも不在。お見舞いのメールとコーテシー（お茶）を入室済み。

3/31午前　ラウンジではお会いできなかったため、お部屋にお電話し、外出前にロビーでお会いしました。
体調はだいぶ良くなり、現在は問題ないとのことでした。メールとコーテシーへのお礼もいただきました。引き続きご出発までGood Care していくよう関連セクションに周知した。　戸部


<A guest reported feeling unwell after having dinner at RCL on the evening of March 29.>
On the morning of March 30,  the guest made a report at RCL. The guest requested ginger tea; however,  as it was not available,  the request was declined. At that time,  the guest stated that they had felt unwell after consuming dinner on March 29,  which led to the issue being identified. It was also reported that they were able to eat normally on the morning of March 30.
Samples of the food served on the evening of March 29 will be checked and sent for MSG testing.

Notes:
Male: reported consuming jellyfish,  cucumber,  and smoked salmon
Female: reported consuming beef
Symptoms: male – diarrhea; female – vomiting

March 30
Ishida

<Update from Culinary Team>
[Service Overview on the Day]
Number of guests during cocktail time: 78
Chinese appetizers (2 types): 30 and 35 portions respectively
Smoked salmon: 2 platters
Sautéed salmon: 1.5 platters
Cucumbers: 1 platter
Meat dishes: 4 platters

[Current Findings]
Retained food samples from the day have been secured and confirmed.
Temperature records for cooked items have been reviewed and confirmed.
No staff members involved in food preparation or service,  including those on duty that day,  have reported any health issues as of now.
No similar cases of illness have been reported by other guests at this time.

On the afternoon of March 30,  Tobe attempted to contact the guest,  however they were not available. A follow-up email and a courtesy amenity (tea) have been delivered to the room.

31 Mar (AM)
Unable to meet them in the lounge,  I called their room and met them in the lobby before their departure.
They stated they are feeling much better and are currently fine. They expressed appreciation for the email and courtesy.
Relevant sections have been informed to continue providing good care until their departure.　Tobe

5 Apr 2026

rows.Subject: 2526 | Ms. Diane Greenough | FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
#2528のゲストが部屋の中に鍵を置いてきたから再発行して欲しいとフロントに立ち寄りありがあった。
その際ゲストは「#2526の部屋」と述べられた。
混雑していたためロビーサービスが事情を伺い、フロント裏にいるスタッフへ報告した。
その際にスタッフ間でID確認済みか否かの意思疎通がうまくできておらず、ID確認済みと解釈してしまった。
鍵をお渡しする際「#2526ですよね」「そうだ」とのやり取りをした。 
ゲストが「扉を開けたら部屋が違った」と降りてきた。改めて部屋番号とIDを確認したころ#2526と#2528をゲストが勘違いをしていた。
ラッチがされていたため完全には開けられてはいないが、#2528のゲストがすぐにドアへ向かい開けたゲストを目撃。
その後フロントへ入電あり。「誰かがドアを開けた。何か盗もうとしていたのかもしれない」と不安そうだったため、新しい鍵をお届けした。 
その後西郷MGRより、正直に経緯を説明し、「分かった」と終話。ご立腹の様子はないですが、当初は不安げな様子ではありました。
3/31 22:00 戸村

A guest from Room #2528 stopped by the front desk requesting a replacement key,  as they had accidentally left their key inside the room. At that time,  the guest stated their room number was #2526.

Due to the busy situation,  the lobby staff gathered the details and reported the request to the back-office staff. However,  there was a miscommunication among staff regarding whether the guest’s ID had been verified,  and it was mistakenly assumed that verification had already been completed. When handing over the key,  staff confirmed,  “#2526,  correct?” and the guest replied,  “Yes.”

Shortly after,  the guest returned stating,  “When I opened the door,  it was the wrong room.” Upon rechecking the room number and ID,  it was found that the guest had confused Room #2526 with #2528.

Although the door latch was engaged and the door was not fully opened,  the guest of Room #2528 immediately approached and witnessed the other guest attempting to open the door. Subsequently,  the guest called the front desk,  expressing concern: “Someone tried to open my door. They might have been trying to steal something.” As a precaution,  a new key was delivered to the guest.

Later,  Manager Saigo explained the situation honestly to the guest,  who responded,  “Understood.” The guest did not appear angry,  although they were initially somewhat uneasy about the incident.   3/31 22:00 Tomura

rows.Feedback Remarks 1:
再度Ms.オウから、今度はチェックイン時の状況をカメラチェックして欲しいと入電。
TEL:080-4920-0880 
防災センターにて動向確認。3/31 18：50～19：10間でチェックインから部屋に入室するまでを確認した。カウンターに財布を置いて忘れた事実なし。GSTは精算にクレジットカードを使用。現金は一切出していない事を確認。また、クレジットカードも手渡しでGSTに返却してご自身で緑色のポーチに閉まってトートバッグに入れていることを確認。
上記時系列をオウ様に説明し終話。

GSTは4/2に減泊してチェックアウト済。4/2田中

Ms. Oh called again, asking us to review the camera footage of the check-in process.
TEL: 080-4920-0880 
We checked the CCTV at the Disaster Prevention Center. We confirmed the sequence of events from check-in to entering the room between 6:50 PM and 7:10 PM on March 31. There was no evidence that she left her wallet at the counter and forgot it. GST used a credit card for payment. It was confirmed that no cash was used at all. Additionally, it was confirmed that the credit card was handed directly to GST, who then placed it in a green pouch and put it into a tote bag.
I explained the above timeline to Ms. O and ended the call.

GST checked out on April 2 after shortening their stay. April 2, Tanaka

08:10
Received an MGR call via ISC. The guest reported that upon returning from breakfast,  there were bloodstains around the toilet area,  and blood-stained toilet paper was floating inside the toilet.

The guest checked in at 20:00 on April 1 and stated that they had used the toilet several times both last night and this morning,  with no bloodstains observed at those times.
The guest was able to re-enter the room with their own room key after breakfast. I informed the guest that we would investigate whether any hotel staff had entered the room,  including checking surveillance cameras and room key access logs,  and that the results would be communicated via a letter.
The guest left the hotel at approximately 8:30 a.m. and is expected to return around 3:00 p.m.　— DM Tanaka

10:55

7:01 a.m.: Two guests left the room together (for breakfast)

7:57 a.m.: The other guest returned

「体がかゆくなった」と申告がありましたが、同室に3名いるがご本人のみ症状が出ているとの事。そのため、ベッドバグの可能性は低いと考えられますが、念のため明日確認する旨を、水谷DMよりご案内しております。GSTは4/3にSleeping Roomとして提供中の#1310に移動します。　4/3HK新井

#2515ご滞在のご主人様より、ランドリーを提出した場合にホテル負担（無料対応）可能かISCへ問い合わせがありました。折り返し連絡を試みましたが不通で、メッセージもピックアップなしのため、 現時点ではホテル内で被害が発生した確証がないため、全衣類のランドリーを無料対応とすることは難しい旨、また#1316号室については専門業者による調査を実施するが、結果判明までに時間を要する点についてご了承いただきたい旨を記載したレターを、各客室のドア下より入室しております。　4/3　HK岩谷

4/4　4月3日、害虫調査業者により客室#1316の調査を実施し、ベッドバグは確認されなかった旨の報告を受けた旨と、その後のご体調はどうかのお伺いレターを入室しております。*調査結果ﾚﾎﾟｰﾄは月曜に送付される予定。（＃2515にも入室済）4/4ＨＫ岩谷

At around 3:00 on April 3,  a guest stopped by the front desk.
The guest reported feeling itchy; however,  there are three people staying in the same room and only this guest is experiencing symptoms. Therefore,  the possibility of bed bugs is considered low,  but as a precaution,  DM Mizutani has informed the guest that we will conduct a check tomorrow.
The guest will be moved on April 3 to room #1310,  which is currently being used as a sleeping room.　4/3 HK Arai

We received an inquiry via ISC from the husband of a guest staying in Room #2515 regarding whether laundry services could be covered by the hotel (free of charge) if items are submitted.

・We attempted to return the call; however,  we have been unable to reach him,  and no message has been picked up.
・At this time,  there is no confirmed evidence that the incident in question occurred within the hotel. Therefore,  it is difficult for us to offer complimentary laundry service for all items.
・A professional inspection of Room #1316 is scheduled to be conducted.
・We kindly ask for your understanding that it will take some time before the results of the investigation are available.
・A letter containing the above information has been distributed under the doors of all guest rooms.　　4/3 HK iwatani

4/4  April 3,  a pest control specialist conducted an inspection of Room #1316 and reported that no bed bugs were found.
We have entered the room to deliver a letter informing the guest of the inspection results and inquiring about their condition thereafter.The official inspection report is scheduled to be sent on Monday. (A letter has also been delivered to Room #2515.)
4/4 iwatani

4/3  23:21pm
FCS1経由でゲストよりトイレの内部が清掃されていなかったと連絡があった。
その後も15分経ってもまだ来ない、とISC宛に催促の電話。ゲストは痺れを切らしマネジャーコールまで発展した。
お客様へは対応の遅れをお詫びした。
23：35に部屋に客室課員が伺ったところ、トイレ内部中央に約2cm四方の茶色い汚れがあった。汚れを落とし、お詫びして退室した。
初動が遅れた原因はいつチェックインをして清掃はいつ入ったのかなど内部調査を進めてしまっていたことだった。
改めてお客様からマネジャー宛に電話があり、返金は要らないから赤ワイン1本と責任者からのレターがあれば私としては十分である、
と主張され、客室課責任者に申し伝えると言って終話した。4/3 23:43 西郷

4/4　11:00AM
清掃不備及び、その後の対応についてご不快な思いをおかけした事についてお詫びレターと赤ワイン、ナッツを清掃時に入室済。また、YD-WQY-CAN-20260403の団体ゲストであった為、川村課長へメールにて報告済み。
4/4　岩谷

4/3 23:21pm
A guest contacted us via FCS1 to report that the inside of the toilet had not been cleaned.
Fifteen minutes later,  the guest called ISC again to follow up,  stating that no one had arrived yet. 
Growing impatient,  the situation escalated to a manager call.
We apologized to the guest for the delay in our response.

At 23:35,  a housekeeping staff member visited the room and found a brown stain approximately 2 cm square in the center inside the toilet. 
The stain was removed,  and the staff apologized before leaving the room.

The delay in the initial response was caused by an internal investigation into details such as when the guest had checked in and when the room had been cleaned.

Later,  the guest called the manager again and stated that a refund was not necessary. Instead,  they said that one bottle of red wine and a letter from the person in charge would be sufficient. The call ended after informing the guest that this request would be communicated to the housekeeping manager.
4/3 23:43pm Saigo

Apr 4,  11:00 AM
An apology letter,  along with a bottle of red wine and nuts,  was placed in the room during cleaning to apologize for the inconvenience caused by the insufficient cleaning and the delay in our subsequent response.
As the guest was part of the group booking YD-WQY-CAN-20260403,  a report has also been sent via email to Sales Kawamura-Sinior Manager.  4/4 HKiwatani

rows.Subject: 1827 | Denil Visharia | FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
4/5 21:45
#1827の部屋を開けたら既に人がいた、とチェックインしたゲストが降りてきた。
本来#1810の鍵をお渡しすべきところをチェックイン担当者が誤って鍵を作成しお渡ししてしまった。
#1810に入るべきゲストにはお詫びして新たに作成し直した。
入られてしまったMr. Vishariaへは直接お会いしお詫びし、鍵の差し替えを行った。
また補償としてParty 2部屋に対し朝食を全日程提供することを約束した。
原因としては#1810をチェックインした際にキーブックに#1827と本人が少し前にチェックインした部屋番号を記入していた。
また#1810の鍵が2枚発行されず、作り直す際に誤記入したキーブックをもとに鍵を作り直していたことが防犯カメラから発覚した。
ご出発時改めてお詫びを行う予定。 4/5 西郷

4/8追記
4/7のステイメイク時に使用したダスターが部屋に残っていた、とゲストより連絡あり。写真付きでアブデル課長宛にメールあり。
4/5のダブルチェックインの際の状況を監視カメラで確認したところ、1827にMr. Vishariaがチェックイン。約30分後に#1810滞在中のゲスト(Mr. Jankowski)が#1827の扉を開けようと試みる。鍵は開かず、奥様と子供は#1827の前で待機。Mr. Jankowskiがロビーへ降りる。その後#1827へ戻り扉を開けようとするも、すぐに3名でロビーへ降りていった。5分ほど後に18階へ戻り#1810へ。実際に1827のドアを開けてしまったかは監視カメラの角度の問題で確認できませんでしたが、#1810のゲストが#1827の中には入っていないことは確認済。　4/8　石田

4/5 21:45
When the guest checked in,  they returned to the front desk stating that there was already someone inside Room #1827 when they opened the door.
The check-in agent mistakenly issued a key for Room #1827 instead of the correct room,  #1810.
We apologized to the guest who was supposed to be assigned Room #1810 and reissued the correct key.
We also met Mr. Visharia,  who had been staying in Room #1827,  in person to apologize and replaced his room key.
As compensation,  we offered complimentary breakfast for the entire stay for both rooms in the party.

The cause of the incident was identified as follows: when checking in Room #1810,  the agent mistakenly wrote #1827 on the key sleeve,  referencing a room number that had been checked in shortly before. Additionally,  since two keys for Room #1810 were not initially issued,  the agent recreated the keys based on the incorrectly written key sleeve. This was later confirmed through security camera footage.

We plan to extend another apology to the guests again at the time of their departure.  4/5 Saigo

4/8 Update
The guest reported that a cleaning duster used during the stay service on April 7 had been left in the room. An email with a photo was sent to Abdel-san.

Upon reviewing the security camera footage regarding the double check-in incident on April 5,  it was confirmed that the guest in question checked into Room #1827. Approximately 30 minutes later,  the guest staying in Room #1810 attempted to open the door to Room #1827. The door did not unlock,  and the wife and child remained waiting in front of Room #1827 while the male guest went down to the lobby.
Subsequently,  the male guest returned to Room #1827 and again attempted to open the door; however,  shortly thereafter,  all three guest went down to the lobby together. About five minutes later,  they returned to the 18th floor and entered Room #1810.

Due to the angle of the security camera,  it could not be confirmed whether the door to Room #1827 was actually opened. However,  it has been confirmed that the guest from Room #1810 did not enter Room #1827.
April 8 – Ishida

April 9, 12:25 p.m. I apologized again at checkout. I offered 25,000 WOH points as compensation from the hotel, and the guest graciously accepted.

↓
病院から戻られ、骨折されていたと発覚。OUT時再度お声がけすることとします。 4/6 丹羽

CCTV画像を確認したところ、当該ゲストは第一生命ビルの自動ドアを出た後、正面玄関より館内へ入っていることが確認された。
このことから、外出後に第一生命ビルのエレベーターを利用して戻られたものと推察される。その後、一旦1980に入店し着席されたものの、痛みが強かったためか、すぐに退出しロビーコンシェルジュへコンタクトされていることが判明。
以上より、ゲストの申告通り、転倒は正面玄関前を含むホテル敷地内ではなく、外部で発生したものであることが確認された。
本日、ゲストへコンタクトし、ご容態をお伺いする予定。4/7　戸部

アブデルさんがゲストの奥様にお会いし、お見舞いを申し上げた。ゲストは昨日のチームのサポートに感謝しているとのことであった。ご出発まで引き続きケアをしていく予定。　4/7　戸部

チェックアウトの際、デューティーマネージャーが直接ゲストにお声がけした。
ゲストより、手術のため母国へ帰国する必要があり、その結果、残りのご旅行をキャンセルせざるを得なくなったとのご説明があった。ロビーコンシェルジュにてお荷物の対応を行い、その後、ゲストは介護タクシーで空港へ向かわれた。
怪我自体はバッドラックだったとのコメントはあったが、ホテルの対応およびサポートに対して感謝のお言葉を頂戴した。4/9   戸部


Around 12:00 on April 6,  the guest stopped by and reported that her husband had fallen from his wheelchair outside the hotel and injured his left shoulder. As most of orthopedic clinics were closed for lunch,  an ambulance was arranged at the guest’s request. 4/6 Niwa
↓
After returning from the hospital,  it was confirmed that he had sustained a fracture. We will check with them again at the time of check-out. 4/6 Niwa

Upon reviewing the CCTV footage,  it was confirmed that the guest exited the Dai-ichi Life Building through the automatic doors and then entered the hotel through the main entrance.Based on this,  it is assumed that the guest returned from outside and used the elevator in the Dai-ichi Life Building.
The guest then briefly entered 1980 and took a seat; however,  likely due to severe pain,  they left shortly afterward and contacted the lobby concierge.
As reported by the guest,  it has been confirmed that the fall did not occur within the hotel premises,  including the area in front of the main entrance,  but rather outside the property.
We will contact the guest today to check on their condition.　April 7　Tobe

Abdel met with the guest’s wife and conveyed our sincere well wishes.
The guest expressed their appreciation for the support provided by the team yesterday.
We will continue to provide care and support until their departure.  April  7
Tobe

Upon check-out,  the Duty Manager personally approached the guest.
The guest informed us that they needed to return to their home country for surgery and,  as a result,  had to cancel the remainder of their travel plans. The Lobby Concierge assisted with handling their luggage,  after which the guest proceeded to the airport by care taxi.
Although the guest described the injury itself as bad luck,  they expressed their appreciation for the care and support provided by the hotel.
April 9　Tobe

On April 8, I spoke with him as he was being discharged.
Both he and his wife seemed sad, and he said, “I’ve just had some bad luck. I have to go back home to have surgery.”

↓
ご立腹の状態でﾌﾛﾝﾄへ立ち寄りあり。自身はLGで、世界中のHyattどこでも自分の名前で2部屋取って支払いもする場合は、RCLｱｸｾｽが付くのになぜだと仰った。通常ｸﾞﾛｰﾊﾞﾘｽﾄ特典はご本人様の部屋にしか付かない旨を説明するも、同じ内容を繰り返される。もう二度と泊まらないと名刺を要求されたため、丹羽の名刺渡してます。GM出せ、と言われましたが不在であると伝えたところ、明日GMと話させろと吐き捨てて立ち去られました。ｱﾌﾞﾃﾞﾙ課長に対応依頼予定。 4/6 丹羽
↓
そのままフロントに立寄ることなくOUTされました。　4/7　水谷

4/6 6:15 PM: Mr. Lai himself stopped by the RCL entrance and asked if his daughter’s room #1510 also had RCL. I explained that she had no access this time since he didn’t have an award,  but he was completely unconvinced,  insisting that it should be available even without an award. I told him that we would make an exception this time as a one-time courtesy and allow RCL,  but he still wouldn’t accept it. He argued that he could use RCL for his family’s room at any Hyatt worldwide and that he was an LG,  not a GB,  and then headed to the lobby to speak with the manager. I have already contacted Iwata DM. 4/6 
↓
They stopped by the front desk in a furious state. They said,  “I’m an LG,  and if I book two rooms under my name and pay for them at any Hyatt worldwide,  I get RCL access,  so why not here?” I explained that Globalist benefits normally only apply to the member’s own room,  but they just kept repeating the same thing. He demanded my business card,  saying he would never stay here again,  so I gave him Niwa’s bussiness card. He demanded to speak with the General Manager,  but when I told him the GM was not available,  he spat out,  “Make sure I speak with the GM tomorrow, ” and stormed off. I plan to request that Abdel-san handle this matter. 4/6 Niwa

rows.Subject: ロビー | N/A N/A | FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
4/7 18:00頃 正面玄関からの強風によりロビーに飾られている桜の鉢植えが横転。桜の木と鉢植えの中の水が正面玄関一帯に散乱した為、ロビー正面玄関付近のエリアを一時的にパテーションで区切り清掃と復旧の対応を行った。

約1時間ほどでフローリストと一般清掃により現状復帰。
当日は風が強かった為正面玄関の自動ドアを片方締切りにしロビーに直接風が入らないようにし対応。
風が弱まるまで継続して締切り対応中。　4/7　石田

今後も強風の予報を注視しながら、主にドアマンからの情報により臨機応変に対応していくこととした。4/13/2026 戸部

At approximately 18:00 on April 7,  strong winds coming through the main entrance caused a potted cherry blossom display in the lobby to topple over. The tree and water from the pot were scattered across the main entrance area,  so the section near the entrance was temporarily cordoned off with partitions while cleaning and restoration were carried out.
Within about one hour,  the area was restored to its original condition by a florist and the cleaning staff.
Due to the strong winds that day,  one of the automatic doors at the main entrance was closed to prevent direct airflow into the lobby. This measure remains in place until the wind subsides.
April 7 – Ishida

We will continue to closely monitor strong wind forecasts and respond flexibly as needed,  primarily based on information provided by the doormen.
April 13,  2026　Tobe

rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
<4/7 RCL利用時の他GSTに対するｸﾚｰﾑ>
こちらのGSTがRCL利用した際、隣の席を利用していたGSTの話声がうるさいとのことで注意をして欲しいとの依頼あり。RCLｶｼｬさんが声を掛けようとしたところご自身で隣のGSTに注意してしまった。その後GSTよりﾏﾈｼﾞｬｰｺｰﾙの依頼がありRCLｽﾀｯﾌより要件を伺うと騒いでいたｹﾞｽﾄに対して何故ｽﾀｯﾌが注意をしないのかとの指摘。すぐﾏﾈｼﾞｬｰを呼ぶことを伝えるも今は話す気分ではない、との事で4/8朝RCL利用時に改めて話したいとの事。RCL中村MGRに事柄共有済　4/7　石田
4/8 9:15頃、そのお客様とお話しすることができました。
お客様からクラブラウンジの利用マナーについてご質問をいただいたため、双方で認識を一致させました。昨日の件については心よりお詫び申し上げるとともに、クラブラウンジの適切な利用基準について、全スタッフに改めて周知徹底することをお約束しました。4/8 中村


<Complaint Regarding Other Guests During RCL Use on 4/7>
While this guest was using RCL,  they requested that staff caution another guest seated nearby for speaking too loudly. When RCL staff member Kasha attempted to address the situation,  the guest personally spoke to the neighboring guest instead.
Subsequently,  the guest requested to speak with a manager. When RCL staff asked about the issue,  the guest pointed out that staff should have been the ones to caution the noisy guests. Although we informed them that a manager would be called immediately,  the guest stated they were not in the mood to talk at that time and would prefer to discuss the matter the following morning (4/8) during their next use of RCL.

The matter has been shared with RCL Manager Nakamura.
April 7 – Ishida
At around 9.15 am on 8 April,  I was able to speak to that customer.
The guest asked about the proper etiquette for using the club lounge,  so we agreed on a common understanding. I offered a sincere apology for yesterday’s incident and promised to re-educate all staff members on the proper standards for the club lounge.　8 April Nakamura

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
コンプレ
IN時、事前にスイートUP希望していたのに叶わず。ﾁｪｯｸｲﾝｸﾗｰｸから丁寧に説明して一度INするもMGR Callとなり、田中部屋に訪問。
①枕とシーツに汚れ有。率直にお詫びを伝えてます。HK MGRとチームに共有する旨伝えてます。
②スイートアップに関して。空きがあればオファーしたいが、滞在中特典として提供が出来るｽﾀﾝﾀﾞｰﾄﾞｽｲｰﾄが満室でアップ出来ないことを丁重に説明。
⇒英語を話せない予約者が憤慨していたが、ACCが英語を話すことができ落ち着いた様子であった為、4/8-1Nのみﾘｶﾊﾞﾘｰとして特別に通常アップグレードの対象ではないが#823(RGXK)に一晩のみアップグレードすることで納得され、ルームチェンジしました。その際、念には念をで、一晩だけである旨と4/9に再度ルームチェンジが必要であると数回に渡り説明して了承いただいてます。ピローミストも動かしてGLOBの為のGiftであると説明済。
なお、XRKの朝食をコンペンセーションとして要求されたがお断りしてます。4/8 21：00田中
↓
RGXKに移ったら、本人も怒りがおさまり、最後にはありがとう。と言ってもらえてます。ただ、ここでも再度、今晩だけの滞在となる旨説明してます。4/8 21：30田中
↓
4/9の空き状況でスタンダードスイートに空きがあれば移動。なければ当日の空き状況で広い部屋にルームチェンジとなります。外出前にフロントに連絡をいただけます。そこで、移動先の部屋タイプを説明してルームチェンジの手続きとなります。眺望は問わないとのこと。4/8 田中

＜HK＞
4/9の#610へのR/Cの際にインナーピロケースの染みに関してのお詫びでレターとGR3入室済み。 4/9 HK筋野

At check-in,  the guest had requested a suite upgrade in advance; however,  we were unable to fulfill this request. The check-in clerk provided a polite explanation,  and the guest initially proceeded with check-in. However,  a manager call was later requested,  and I (Tanaka) visited the room.
①There were stains on the pillow and sheets. I offered a sincere apology and informed the guest that this would be shared with the Housekeeping Manager and team. 
②Regarding the suite upgrade: I explained politely that we would have liked to offer an upgrade if availability permitted; however,  the standard suites that can be provided as a stay benefit were fully booked,  so we were unable to upgrade.
⇒The guest who made the reservation does not speak English and became upset. However,  the accompanying guest is able to speak English and appeared calm. As a recovery gesture,  I made a special exception and upgraded the guest for one night only (April 8,  1 night) to Room #823 (RGXK),  which is not normally eligible for upgrades. The guest accepted this,  and we proceeded with a room change.
At that time,  to ensure full understanding,  we clearly explained multiple times that:
the upgrade was for one night only,  and another room change would be required on April 9.
The guest acknowledged and agreed. A pillow mist was also moved to the new room and explained as a gift for a GLOB member.
Additionally,  the guest requested breakfast at XRK as compensation,  but this was declined.　April 8,  21:00 – Tanaka
↓
After moving to the RGXK room,  the guest’s anger subsided,  and they eventually expressed their thanks. I again reiterated that the stay in this room was for one night only.　April 8,  21:30 – Tanaka
↓
For April 9,  if a standard suite becomes available,  the guest will be moved there. If not,  we will arrange a room change to a larger room based on same-day availability. The guest will contact the front desk before going out,  at which time we will explain the new room type and proceed with the room change. The guest stated that they have no preference regarding the view.　April 8 – Tanaka

＜HK＞
A letter of apology and a GR3 amenity were placed in the room regarding the stain on the inner pillowcase at the time of the room change to Room #610 on April 9. HKsujino

rows.Subject: 不泊の外国人の不退去
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
4/12早朝4:00頃タクシードライバーと共に泥酔した外国人女性が来館。ホテルまでのタクシー代が支払えずドライバーからのヘルプ要請。
詳細を確認するとホテルに宿泊予約はなし。身分証、携帯電話、現金一切持ち合わせなし。泥酔しているため正しい名前も確認できず。
ホテルに泊まりたいと言われるも身分証と支払い能力の保証が無ければ宿泊することはできないことを案内。フロントカウンターにもたれかかったまま寝ようとしたため退去していただくよう勧告。この時点でタクシードライバーは支払い不能と自身で判断し料金を受け取らないまま退館。その後も誰かを呼んでとしか言わない為、このままでは警察を呼ぶことになると伝えると同意した為4:30AM防災センターに連絡し警察に通報。4：45頃男性警察官2名が来館、状況を説明し警察に対応を変わる。警察官が来た段階で外国人女性より警察にホテルスタッフにお金を渡したが返してくれないとの発言があったがそういった事実は無し。

警察官が外国人女性のカバンを検査した所在留カードを確認。横浜市在住の在日外国人だった為、警察よりタクシーか電車で帰るよう案内。電車で帰る申告があり、警察へ連れられ新宿駅へ出発し対応終了。　4/12　石田

At approximately 4:00 AM on April 12,  an intoxicated foreign woman arrived at the property accompanied by a taxi driver. The driver requested assistance because she was unable to pay the taxi fare to the hotel.
Upon confirming the details,  it was found that she did not have a reservation at the hotel. She also had no identification,  mobile phone,  or cash. Due to her intoxicated state,  her correct name could not be confirmed.
Although she requested to stay at the hotel,  she was informed that accommodation could not be provided without valid identification and a guarantee of payment. As she attempted to sleep while leaning on the front desk counter,  she was advised to leave the premises. At that point,  the taxi driver determined that payment was not possible and left without collecting the fare.
She repeatedly stated only “please call someone, ” and as the situation could not be resolved,  we informed that the police would be called. Upon her agreement,  the Disaster Prevention Center was contacted at 4:30 AM,  and the police were notified. At approximately 4:45 AM,  two male police officers arrived. The situation was explained,  and the matter was handed over to the police.
After the police arrived,  the woman claimed that she had given money to the hotel staff but that it had not been returned; however,  no such fact was confirmed.

The police inspected her bag and located a residence card. As she was identified as a foreign resident living in Yokohama City,  the police instructed her to return home by taxi or train. She stated that she would return by train and was escorted by the police to Shinjuku Station,  concluding the response.

April 12
Ishida

Relationship Trouble.  4/13 Saigo
rows.Subject: 2332 | Mr. Mahmoud Faragallah | FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Other Issue フロントその他
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
4/13 07:00am
ISC宛に#2232および#2331より、「上階がうるさい」「隣室が叫んでいる」とそれぞれクレームが入る。 
ロビーサービススタッフが現場へ急行したところ、男女が口論している様子が確認されたとの報告あり。 
その後しばらくして、女性ゲストがロビーへ降りてきて、体を震わせながらスタッフに助けを求めた。
女性は、携帯電話を取り上げられたこと、家族を罵倒されたこと、また暴力を振るわれたと主張していた。 
携帯電話の回収のため、西郷が同行し客室へ向かったが不在であった。
その後、喫煙所にいる可能性があるとのことで確認に向かったところ、B1階エレベーターホールにて男性と遭遇した。 
携帯電話はその場で直ちに返却されたが、その後も女性は叫び続けている状態であった。 
男性は終始申し訳なさそうな様子であった。
暴力の有無について確認したところ、「暴力は振るっていない」と否定し、代わりに女性からの暴力があったとして自身の顔の傷を示した。
また男性より、女性はパニック障害を抱えており、精神状態の浮き沈みが激しいとの説明があった。 
その後、両名はB1階にて一定時間、付かず離れずの状態で滞在していたが、午前8時前、待機していたタクシーに乗車しチェックアウトとなった。ご迷惑をおかけした#2232および#2331は共に本日チェックアウト。ご出発時にお詫びを行った。　4/13 西郷

4/13 07:00am
To ISC,  complaints were received from rooms #2232 and #2331 regarding noise,  stating that the upper floor was loud and that a neighboring room was shouting.

Hotel Lobby Service staff responded to the scene,  where a verbal argument between a male and a female guest was reported to be in progress.

Shortly thereafter,  the female guest came down to the lobby,  visibly shaking,  and sought assistance from staff. She claimed that her mobile phone had been taken from her,  that her family had been verbally abused,  and that she had been subjected to physical violence.

In order to retrieve the mobile phone,  Saigo accompanied the guest to the room; however,  the male guest was not present. It was then suggested that he might be in the smoking area,  so they proceeded to check there. The male guest was subsequently found in the B1 elevator lobby.
The mobile phone was immediately returned on site. However,  the female guest continued to shout thereafter.

The male guest appeared apologetic throughout. When asked about the alleged physical violence,  he denied having used any violence and instead stated that he had been assaulted by the female guest,  showing injuries on his face.

The male guest also stated that the female guest suffers from a panic disorder and experiences significant mood fluctuations.

Both guests remained in the B1 area for some time,  staying in close proximity but not interacting. Before 8:00 a.m.,  they boarded a waiting taxi and checked out. 
Rooms #2232 and #2331,  which were both affected,  have checked out today. An apology was offered at the time of their departure.
 4/13 Saigo

rows.Subject: 2631 | Mrs. Tan Lee Tair | HK Damage/Lost Guest item 客室ゲスト持ち物破壊/紛失
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: HK Damage/Lost Guest item 客室ゲスト持ち物破壊/紛失
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
2026/4/12 18:00
FCS1経由にて、ゲストより「外出前にベッドの上に置いていたベージュのジャケット（ブランド：Autograph Birmingham）がなくなっている」との申告を受けた。
ハウスキーピングスタッフがゲストへ連絡を試みたが、すでに外出されており連絡が取れなかった。
ゲストへは詳細確認したい旨のレターを客室へ入室し、コンタクトを待った。
同時に、客室から回収されたリネン類およびゴミを確認しましたが、該当品は発見されなかった。

4/13 08:00
ゲストより連絡があり、ハウスキーピングスタッフ（中野）がお部屋へ伺い、状況の再確認を行い, 
以下の内容が確認された：
ジャケットは4月12日の外出前に（ベッド上またはクローゼット内のいずれかに）置いていた。
ジャケットは4月11日の夜時点では確実に存在していた。
ジャケットに加え、テレビ台に置いていた小銭入りの小袋も紛失している。
以上の内容を受け、調査のため時間をいただく旨をお伝えし一旦終話。

調査内容:
当該客室を担当したハウスキーピングスタッフおよび清掃会社スタッフへの聞き取りを実施したが、いずれのスタッフも該当物品を見ておらず、また触れていないとの回答であった。
念のため、防犯カメラ映像およびキーカード利用履歴を確認したが、ホテルスタッフによる不審な行動や物品持ち出しの形跡は確認されなかった。

4/13 11:00
ゲストがロビーに来館され、以下の内容で調査結果をご説明：
全スタッフがゲストの私物に関与していないこと。
防犯カメラおよびキーログにおいても不審な行動は確認されなかったこと。
以上の点より、ホテルスタッフが物品を持ち出した可能性は低い旨をご説明。
ゲストからの要望としてはスタッフを疑っているわけではないものの、保険請求のために「客室内から物品がなくなった事実」を記載した報告書の作成を希望。
ホテルとしては「ホテル側の過失による紛失」との記載はできない旨をご説明し、ゲストも了承。
なお小銭の紛失については対応不要とのご意向を示されました。
戸部部長へ相談のうえ、本件を経過報告書としてまとめ、ゲストへメールにて送付予定です。
→ゲストへメールしケースクローズとした。


On April 12 at approximately 18:05
The  FCS1 received a report from the guest stating that a beige jacket (brand: Autograph Birmingham),  which had been left on the bed prior to leaving the room,  was missing.

Details of Actions Taken:

April 12,  2026

Housekeeping staff attempted to contact the guest; however,  the guest had already left the hotel and could not be reached.
A letter was placed in the guest room requesting further details.
At the same time,  all linen and waste removed from the room were checked; however,  the reported item was not found.

April 13,  2026 (08:00)

The guest contacted the hotel,  and Housekeeping staff (Nakano) visited the room to reconfirm the situation.
The following details were confirmed with the guest:
The jacket had been left in the room (either on the bed or in the closet) before going out on April 12.
The jacket was confirmed to be present on the night of April 11.
In addition to the jacket,  a small pouch containing coins that had been placed on the TV stand was also reported missing.
The guest was informed that time would be needed to conduct an investigation.

Investigation:

Interviews were conducted with the housekeeping staff and the external cleaning company staff responsible for the room. All personnel stated that they had neither seen nor handled the reported items.
As a precaution,  security camera footage and key card access logs were reviewed. No suspicious activity or evidence of hotel staff removing any items from the room was identified.

April 13,  2026 (11:00)

The guest visited the lobby and was provided with an explanation of the findings:
All staff confirmed that they had neither seen nor handled the guest’s belongings.
Security footage and key logs did not indicate any suspicious behavior by hotel staff.
Based on the above,  the guest was informed that there is no evidence to suggest that the items were removed by hotel staff.

Guest Request:
The guest stated that they do not suspect hotel staff; however,  they requested a written report documenting that the item was missing from the room for insurance purposes.
It was explained that the hotel cannot state that the loss was caused by hotel negligence,  and the guest acknowledged and agreed to this.
The guest confirmed that it would be sufficient for the report to state that the item was missing from the room.
Additionally,  the guest indicated that no further action is required regarding the missing coins.

Next Steps:
After internal consultation with the department head,  the hotel will prepare and send this incident report to the guest via email as a record of the situation.
→　An email was sent to the guest,  and the case has been closed.　HKiwatani

rows.Subject: 2403 | Mr. John De Martino Jr | HK Service Complaint 客室課サービス苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: HK Service Complaint 客室課サービス苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
2026/4/14 14:40
フロント石田さんよりゲストから部屋のDDランプを点けていたにも関わらず誰かが勝手にドアを開けて入ろうとしたとのことで
大変激怒しておりHK中野が対応依頼を受ける。
HK中野がお部屋へ伺ったところ怒り心頭での様子でお話をされた。
概要としては
・DDランプを点けているのに誰かが勝手に入ってこようとした。
・部屋に入る前に電話連絡をするべきではないか。
・海外だったら不審者かと思い警察を呼ぶ事態だ。
状況を説明するも全く納得されず、また中野もゲストの話を全て正確に理解できていないことから他のスタッフを呼べと言われる。
岩谷課長に報告し、フロントAbdel課長へケアを依頼した。
Abdel課長がゲストとお話をし、お詫びとしてクラブラウンジのアクセスを付与した。　

今回クレームとなった要因はDD点灯時、24時間ごとの安否確認をする際は事前に連絡を入れてから部屋へ入室というオペレーションになっているが事前の電話連絡を怠ったことが要因となっている。（ゲストもそこを強く言っていた）
また安否確認の際は事前に連絡を入れることもノーティスに記載されている。　　HK中野

4/14　お詫び対応としてクラブラウンジアクセスを付与。また、アウト時改めてお詫び。　4/14ＨＫ岩谷

April 14,  2026,  14:40

Front staff Mr. Ishida received a complaint from a guest stating that despite having the Do Not Disturb (DND) light on,  someone attempted to open the door and enter the room without permission. The guest was extremely upset,  and HK Nakano was asked to respond.

When Nakano visited the room,  the guest was in a state of extreme anger and explained the situation as follows:

Despite the DND light being on,  someone tried to enter the room without permission.
There should have been a phone call prior to attempting entry.
In another country,  this could have been considered suspicious behavior and might have led to calling the police.

Although Nakano attempted to explain the situation,  the guest was not convinced at all. Additionally,  since Nakano was unable to fully understand all of the guest’s concerns,  the guest requested to speak with another staff member.

Housekeeping Manager Iwatani was informed,  and Front Manager Abdel was asked to take over the case. After speaking with the guest,  Manager Abdel apologized and offered complimentary access to the Club Lounge as a gesture of goodwill.

The cause of this complaint was that,  although the standard procedure requires staff to make prior contact before entering a room for a 24-hour safety check when the DND light is on,  the phone call was not made in advance. The guest strongly emphasized this point. Additionally,  the requirement to contact the guest beforehand is clearly stated in the notice regarding safety checks.     -HK Nakano
4/14: Club lounge access granted as a gesture of apology. We also plan to offer another apology upon checkout. 4/14 HK Iwatani.

rows.Incident Description:

16:52 Earthquake off Sanriku Coast Max 5+ (Shinjuku: 2) 4/20 Saigo
rows.Subject: Others その他 | N/A N/A | Earthquake 地震
rows.Source of Complaint: Reported by a Colleague スタッフからの報告
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: Earthquake 地震
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
16:52 地震発生（三陸沖）
最大震度5強（新宿区：震度2）。その後、津波警報等が発令された。

当ホテルの震度計では26ガルを記録し、シャンデリアに揺れを確認した。
エレベーターは、客用については停止なし。従業員用の12・13号機（非常用）は約2分間停止したが、閉じ込めの発生はなかった。

ロビーにはもともと団体客が滞在していたが、これに加え、避難のために降りてくるゲストも見受けられた。
ISC宛には計8件の問い合わせがあった。

なお、地震との関連は不明であるが、20階において防火扉が閉鎖する事象が発生した。　4/20 西郷


16:52 Earthquake (Off Sanriku Coast)
Maximum seismic intensity: 5+ (Shinjuku: 2). A tsunami warning/advisory was subsequently issued.

The hotel’s seismometer recorded 26 gal,  and swaying of chandeliers was observed.
Guest elevators remained operational with no stoppages. 
Staff elevators No. 12 and 13 (emergency use) were temporarily suspended for approximately two minutes; however,  no entrapments occurred.

The lobby was already occupied by a tour group,  and additional guests evacuated to the lobby following the earthquake.
A total of eight inquiries were received by ISC.

Although the cause is unclear and may not be related to the earthquake,  an incident was reported in which a fire door on the 20th floor closed.  4/20 Saigo
rows.Feedback Remarks 1: Case Close
rows.item_norm: Earthquake 地震

MYHIAP+STEX利用でRGSKにチェックイン。

On April 24,  the guest checked in to RGSK using MYHIAP + STEX benefits.
Shortly after check-in,  the guest approached the Front Desk to express dissatisfaction with the condition of the assigned room,  describing it as outdated. Mr. Kevin from Aspire Travel subsequently contacted the Front Desk by phone and also sent an email to the Sales Department regarding the situation.
As all higher room categories were fully occupied,  a complimentary amenity to GR3 was offered as a gesture of apology.

The reservation has been canceled in Opera,  and the check-in record has been voided accordingly.

April 24 Ishida

rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
2026年4月25日　AM07:30
FCS1経由で1010号室のゲストより「4月24日に電動歯ブラシ（白）が紛失した」との申告があったため状況を確認したところ、以下の点が判明。
・当該ゲストは、1603号室 → 733号室 → 1010号室とR/CHGを行っているが元の客室には該当品は確認されていない。（ゴミやリネン類から　　
　も発見されず）
・ゲストとの会話の中で「1433号室で紛失した可能性がある」との申し出があったため確認したところ、恐らく部屋番号を間違えており、　
　実際には1433号室ではなく、2433号室がParty部屋であったことが判明。
・2433号室も、4月24日に734号室へR/CHGを実施しており、R/CHG前にHKラマが客室内を確認したところ、洗面台に電動歯ブラシが置かれて　
　いたことを確認。そのため、他の荷物（バッグ）と一緒にした。
・2433号室のR/CHGを担当したLC後藤も当時の状況を記憶しており、荷物とともに電動歯ブラシがあったことを認識している。それらの荷
　物と一緒に734号室へ運び、歯ブラシは洗面台左に設置したとの証言あり。

なお、HKラマおよびLC後藤の双方がたまたま撮影した荷物の写真においても、移動前および移動中のいずれにも電動歯ブラシが写っていることを確認済み。
念のためキーログを確認したが、LC後藤がお荷物を734号室へ搬入後、ホテルスタッフが同室へ入室した記録はなし。（補足：4月25日の朝ゲスト外出後に、1010号室を再確認した際、昨日734号室に搬入された荷物が1010号室へ移動されており、ゲスト自身で移動したものと思われる。）

以上の状況から、ホテルスタッフが紛失した等の形跡は見られず、ゲスト間での認識違い、もしくは同行者の荷物に紛れている可能性があると思われる。
そのため、ゲストへは「ホテルスタッフは電動歯ブラシを確実にお荷物とともに移動しており、その後は客室に入室していないため、今一度同行者様にもご確認いただくとともにお荷物を再確認していただきたい」という旨を記載したレターを入室した。　HK中野
↓
4/26　08：15
ゲストより荷物の中から見つかったと連絡あり。　HK中野

April 25,  2026,  07:30 AM

A guest in Room 1010 reported via FCS1 that a white electric toothbrush had gone missing on April 24. Upon investigation,  the following was confirmed:

The guest had changed rooms multiple times (Room 1603 → Room 733 → Room 1010). However,  the item in question was not found in any of the previously occupied rooms,  including in the trash or linen.
During our conversation,  the guest mentioned the possibility that the item had been lost in Room 1433. Upon verification,  it was determined that this was likely a mistake,  and that the correct room was Room 2433,  which had been used for a party.
Room 2433 was changed to Room 734 on April 24. Prior to the room change,  HK Rama checked the room and confirmed that the electric toothbrush was placed on the washbasin. It was then grouped together with the guest’s other belongings (bags).
LC Goto,  who handled the room change for Room 2433,  also recalls the situation and confirms that the electric toothbrush was among the guest’s belongings. These items were transported to Room 734,  and the toothbrush was placed on the left side of the washbasin.

Additionally,  photos taken by both HK Rama and LC Goto coincidentally captured the guest’s belongings,  and the electric toothbrush is visible in both the pre-move and during-move images.
As a precaution,  the key log was checked. After LC Goto delivered the belongings to Room 734,  there is no record of hotel staff entering the room.
(Note: On the morning of April 25,  after the guest had left,  Room 1010 was rechecked. The belongings that had been moved to Room 734 the previous day were found in Room 1010,  indicating that the guest had likely moved them personally.)
Based on the above,  there is no indication that the hotel staff lost the item. It is likely a misunderstanding on the part of the guest or that the item may have been mixed in with a companion’s belongings.
Accordingly,  a letter was placed in the guest’s room stating that the hotel staff had securely moved the electric toothbrush together with the guest’s belongings,  and that no staff had entered the room afterward. The guest was also requested to reconfirm their belongings and check with their companions.
-HK Nakano

4/26 08:15
The guest reported that it was found in their luggage. — HK Nakano

RCLで勤務していた配膳アルバイトスタッフが救急搬送された件につきまして、その後の状況をご報告いたします。

中村マネジャーより、お母さまへお見舞いとともに状況確認のご連絡をいたしました。

当該スタッフは数日前に発熱があり、風邪薬を服用しておりましたが、体調が回復したため勤務に復帰しておりました。
搬送後、病院にて吸引処置（ドレナージ）が行われ、現在は状態も安定し、通常どおり会話が可能な状態まで回復しております。
診断は肺気胸で、現在はCT検査等の精密検査のため入院しております。
昨年夏にも同様の症状があったことから、今後手術の要否について医師が判断を行っております。
今後の進展については、配膳会社を通じて共有いただき、ホテル側にも連携される予定です。

なお、お母さまからは、当ホテルの対応および配慮に対し、感謝のお言葉をいただいております。4/29　戸部

配膳会責任者の工藤様へ確認を行いました。
その後の状況として、カトウさんは手術を受けられ、無事成功し、現在は回復に向かわれているとのこと（ご家族様よりの情報）。
なお、現時点ではまだ入院中となっており、今後進展があり次第ご連絡いただけるよう、改めて依頼済みです。5/4　RCL 中村
↓
本日無事退院したと報告あり。5/6　戸部

Via RCL Sekino requested an ambulance dispatch to the Duty Manager.
Part-time staff member: 20-year-old Japanese male,  Makoto Kato,  with a history of pneumothorax.
Around 20:00,  he reported chest/lung discomfort and was sitting in the back area,  but his condition did not improve and the distress continued,  so he personally requested emergency transport. DM Tanaka made the request via the Disaster Prevention Center at 20:25.
↓
Emergency responders arrived at 20:25 and proceeded to RCL via the back route. He was transported to Tokyo Women's Medical University Hospital.
Since the Haizen company in-charge had already left,  Sekino accompanied him to the hospital. (20:55 Tanaka)
↓
The Haizen company was contacted,  and their representative went directly to the hospital. After arrival,  Sekino handed over and returned to the hotel. (22:00 Tanaka)
↓
Further to the incident involving the RCL part-time staff member who was taken to the hospital,  please find the latest update below.

Manager Nakamura contacted the staff member’s mother to express concern and confirm his condition.

The staff member had experienced a fever several days prior and took cold medication. As his condition improved,  he returned to work.
At the hospital,  a drainage procedure (suction) was performed,  and his condition has since stabilized. He is now able to speak normally.
He has been diagnosed with pneumothorax and is currently hospitalized for further examinations,  including a CT scan.
As he had a similar condition last summer,  doctors are assessing whether surgery will be required.
Any further updates will be communicated via the staffing agency and shared with the hotel accordingly.

The staff member’s mother expressed appreciation for the hotel’s support and care.　4/29 Tobe
↓
The above matter was confirmed with Mr. Kudo,  the person in charge of the Haizen company.
As for the latest update,  Mr. Kato has undergone surgery,  which was successful,  and he is currently on the road to recovery (based on information from his family).However,  he remains hospitalized at this time. We have requested Mr. Kudo to keep us informed should there be any further updates.
May 4 RCL Nakamura
↓
We have received a report that he was safely discharged from the hospital today.
May 6,  Tobe

rows.Incident Item Name: HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備
rows.Incident Description:
清掃不備でｸﾚｰﾑあり　4/30　水谷
There was a complaint due to insufficient cleaning.　4/30　Mizutani
rows.Subject: 1812 | Mr. Kwan Shing Eric Chau | HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: HK Cleanliness/Working Order 客室清掃/機器の不備
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
21：20にISC経由でDM宛に入電。今部屋に戻ったところだが、清掃がされていないとｸﾚｰﾑあり。ﾊﾟｼﾞｬﾏも畳まれていない、机も汚れたまま、枕も椅子の上に置かれたまま、部屋も埃っぽいとのこと。ｽﾀｯﾌお部屋に伺うよう伝えるも休みたいとのことで不要。R/Cも休みたいので不要とのこと。これまで2日間はこんなことなかったのに、今日はTrainieeが清掃したのか。自分もﾎﾃﾙで働いているから今日がひどいことが分かる。と言ってｶﾞﾁｬ切りされました。HKの記録では先2日間とは異なるｽﾀｯﾌの清掃ではあったが、清掃をした記録はあり。休みたいことを強調されていたので、4/30はｱｸｼｮﾝを起こしません。5/1朝一でにHK MGRに報告+OUT時お詫び予定。　4/30　水谷
アウト時に再度丁重にお詫び済み。　5/1 HK岩谷

At 21:20,  a call was received via ISC directed to DM. The guest had just returned to the room and complained that it had not been cleaned. They said the pajamas were not folded,  the desk was still dirty,  the pillow had been left on the chair,  and the room was dusty.
We informed them that staff could come to the room,  but they declined,  saying they wanted to rest. They also declined a room change (R/C) for the same reason. The guest mentioned that the past two days had not been like this and asked whether a trainee had cleaned the room today. They added that they also work in a hotel and could tell how bad the condition was,  then hung up abruptly.
According to HK records,  although a different staff member than the previous two days handled the cleaning,  there is a record that cleaning was performed. As the guest strongly emphasized wanting to rest,  no further action was taken on 4/30. The matter will be reported to the HK Manager first thing on 5/1,  and an apology will be made at check-out.　4/30 Mizutani
Apologized again sincerely at the time of check-out.
5/1 HK Iwatani

rows.Incident Item Name: FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Subject: 1728 | Ms. Weifang Zheng | FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation/Follow Up 1: FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情
rows.Investigation Remarks 1:
R/Sに通じて上の階がすごく煩くて眠れないと申告あり。R/S久保田さんに伺ったところ、英語が話せないため、翻訳機の音声を受話器に向かって流していたようで「上の階で足踏みをしています。もう寝る時間です。」などと話している音声だったとのこと。LCが周囲を確認したが音は無かった、英語NGの為Call Back時LCのワンさんに電話で結果+音に気になるの場合R/C提案も含めて説明したが、5/1OUTの為、不要との事。もし、また音がするようであればいつでも連絡するようGSTに伝え済。4/30 アリスカ

A report was received via R/S that the guest could not sleep due to loud noise from the room above. When we checked with Ms. Kubota from R/S,  he said he does not speak English,  so he played a translation device into the receiver. The audio said things like,  “There is stomping from the room above. It is already time to sleep.”
LC checked the surrounding area but did not detect any noise. As the guest does not speak English,  LC staff  Mr. Wang called back to explain the findings and also offered a room change (R/C) in case the noise remained a concern. However,  the guest declined since they are checking out on 5/1.
The guest has been informed to contact us anytime if the noise occurs again.　4/30 Ariska
rows.item_norm: FO Noise Complaint 騒音苦情

charts.name: VIP Service Risk
charts.explanation: Tracks incident burden affecting VIP guests where recovery sensitivity is highest.
charts.formula: VIP Incident Share%=COUNT(is_vip=1)/COUNT(All Incidents)*100

charts.name: VIP Incident by Status
charts.explanation: Status composition for VIP incidents only.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Incident Status WHERE is_vip=1

charts.name: Incidents by Departments (Drilldown)
charts.explanation: Department share with drilldown to top 10 incident item within each department.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Department; drilldown Top 10 Item BY Department

charts.name: VIP Incident by Departments vs Status
charts.explanation: VIP incident status split across top 10 departments.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Top 10 Department, Incident Status WHERE is_vip=1

charts.name: Incident by Top 10 Category
charts.explanation: Top 10 categories based on incident count.
charts.formula: TOP 10 Incident Category BY COUNT(Incident Case)

charts.name: Hotel vs Department Incident
charts.explanation: Heatmap of incident concentration by hotel and top departments.
charts.formula: X=Hotel, Y=Top Departments, Value=COUNT(Incident Case)

charts.name: VIP Incident by Status (Drilldown)
charts.explanation: VIP status share with drilldown to department within each VIP status.
charts.formula: COUNT(VIP Incidents) BY Status; drilldown Department BY Status

charts.name: Incidents by Top 10 Category (Drilldown)
charts.explanation: Category share with drilldown to incident item within each category.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Top 10 Category; drilldown Item BY Category

charts.name: Incident Volume vs Closure Rate Trend
charts.explanation: Dual-axis trend of incident volume and closure rate.
charts.formula: Column: COUNT(Incident Case), Line: COUNT(Completed)/COUNT(All)*100 BY Time Grain

charts.name: Status Mix
charts.explanation: Operational state composition of completed, pending, and cancelled cases.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Incident Status

charts.name: Incident Heat Over Time by Hour
charts.explanation: Reveals intraday peak windows to optimize shift-level staffing (00 to 23).
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Hour

charts.name: Open Backlog vs Closure Rate Trend
charts.explanation: Combines unresolved case load and closure efficiency in one trend for faster executive read: backlog should decline while closure rate rises.
charts.formula: Open Backlog(t)=COUNT(Status IN ('Open','Pending','In Progress')) BY Time Grain; Closure Rate%(t)=COUNT(Status='Completed')/COUNT(All Incidents)*100 BY Time Grain

charts.name: Severity Risk Profile
charts.explanation: Distribution of incidents by severity to identify current risk mix and escalation burden.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Severity

charts.name: Department Closure %
charts.explanation: Department-level closure efficiency benchmark for accountability and coaching.
charts.formula: Department Closure%=COUNT(Status='Completed')/COUNT(All Incidents)*100 BY Department

charts.name: Category Contribution
charts.explanation: Shows which categories contribute most to total incidents to focus improvement programs.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Incident Category

charts.name: Top Incident Items
charts.explanation: Ranks specific issue items by frequency to prioritize corrective action plans.
charts.formula: TOP 10 Incident Item Name BY COUNT(Incident Case)

charts.name: Top Recurrent Rooms
charts.explanation: Identifies room hotspots with repeated issues for preventive maintenance and CAPEX targeting.
charts.formula: TOP 10 Room No BY COUNT(is_repeat_incident=1)

charts.name: Complaint Channel Performance
charts.explanation: Complaint-source distribution to evaluate channel pressure and engagement behavior.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Source of Complaint

charts.name: Booking Source Quality
charts.explanation: Assesses incident distribution by booking source for channel quality monitoring.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Booking Source

charts.name: Incident Heat by Weekday
charts.explanation: Highlights day-of-week demand peaks for staffing and management coverage planning.
charts.formula: COUNT(Incident Case) BY Weekday

charts.name: Complaint Capture Rate
charts.explanation: Data quality metric indicating how consistently complaint channels are captured.
charts.formula: Capture%=COUNT(Source of Complaint IS NOT NULL)/COUNT(All Incidents)*100

charts.name: Pending Concentration
charts.explanation: Shows which departments hold the largest pending queue share.
charts.formula: COUNT(Status='Pending') BY Department
